translations.chinese: 秦始皇帝者，秦莊襄王子也。
translations.literal: Qin Shi Huang Di was Qin Zhuang Xiang Wang's son.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Shihuang was the son of King Zhuangxiang of Qin.

context.next: 莊襄王為秦質子於趙，見呂不韋姬，悅而取之，生始皇。

translations.chinese: 莊襄王為秦質子於趙，見呂不韋姬，悅而取之，生始皇。
translations.literal: Zhuang Xiang Wang was Qin hostage in Zhao, saw Lu Bu Wei's concubine, pleased and took her, gave birth to Shi Huang.
translations.idiomatic: While King Zhuangxiang was a hostage in Zhao, he saw Lü Buwei's concubine, took a liking to her, married her, and she gave birth to the First Emperor.

context.previous: 秦始皇帝者，秦莊襄王子也。
context.next: 以秦昭王四十八年正月生於邯鄲。

translations.chinese: 以秦昭王四十八年正月生於邯鄲。
translations.literal: He was born in Handan in the first month of the forty-eighth year of King Zhaoxiang of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in Handan in the first month of Qin King Zhaoxiang's forty-eighth year.

context.previous: 莊襄王為秦質子於趙，見呂不韋姬，悅而取之，生始皇。
context.next: 及生，名為政，姓趙氏。

translations.chinese: 及生，名為政，姓趙氏。
translations.literal: Upon his birth, he was named Zheng and given the surname Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: When he was born, he was named Zheng and took the surname Zhao.

context.previous: 以秦昭王四十八年正月生於邯鄲。
context.next: 年十三歲，莊襄王死，政代立為秦王。

translations.chinese: 年十三歲，莊襄王死，政代立為秦王。
translations.literal: At thirteen years of age, King Zhuangxiang died, and Zheng succeeded him as King of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: At age thirteen, King Zhuangxiang died and Zheng succeeded him as King of Qin.

context.previous: 及生，名為政，姓趙氏。
context.next: 當是之時，秦地已并巴、蜀、漢中，越宛有郢，置南郡矣；

translations.chinese: 當是之時，秦地已并巴、蜀、漢中，越宛有郢，置南郡矣；
translations.literal: When this time, Qin territory already annexed Ba, Shu, Han middle, passed Wan had Ying, established south commandery;
translations.idiomatic: At this time, Qin territory had already annexed Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong; it extended past Wan to include Ying, and established Nan commandery;

context.previous: 年十三歲，莊襄王死，政代立為秦王。
context.next: 北收上郡以東，有河東、太原、上黨郡；

translations.chinese: 北收上郡以東，有河東、太原、上黨郡；
translations.literal: North collected Shang commandery east, had Hedong, Taiyuan, Shangdang commanderies;
translations.idiomatic: To the north it had collected the lands east of Shang commandery, including Hedong, Taiyuan, and Shangdang commanderies;

context.previous: 當是之時，秦地已并巴、蜀、漢中，越宛有郢，置南郡矣；
context.next: 東至滎陽，滅二周，置三川郡。

translations.chinese: 東至滎陽，滅二周，置三川郡。
translations.literal: To the east it reached Xingyang, destroyed the two Zhou states, and established Sanchuan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: To the east, Qin reached Xingyang, destroyed the two Zhou states, and established Sanchuan commandery.

context.previous: 北收上郡以東，有河東、太原、上黨郡；
context.next: 呂不韋為相，封十萬戶，號曰文信侯。

translations.chinese: 呂不韋為相，封十萬戶，號曰文信侯。
translations.literal: Lü Buwei served as chancellor, was enfeoffed with one hundred thousand households, and titled Lord Wenxin.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Buwei became chancellor, was enfeoffed with one hundred thousand households, and was titled Lord Wenxin.

context.previous: 東至滎陽，滅二周，置三川郡。
context.next: 招致賓客游士，欲以并天下。

translations.chinese: 招致賓客游士，欲以并天下。
translations.literal: He recruited guests and wandering scholars, intending to unify the world.
translations.idiomatic: He recruited guests and wandering scholars with the aim of unifying the world.

context.previous: 呂不韋為相，封十萬戶，號曰文信侯。
context.next: 李斯為舍人。

translations.chinese: 李斯為舍人。
translations.literal: Li Si served as an attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Li Si served as his attendant.

context.previous: 招致賓客游士，欲以并天下。
context.next: 蒙驁、王齮、麃公等為將軍。

translations.chinese: 蒙驁、王齮、麃公等為將軍。
translations.literal: Meng Ao, Wang Qi, Bi Gong, and others served as generals.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Ao, Wang Qi, Bi Gong, and others served as generals.

context.previous: 李斯為舍人。
context.next: 王年少，初即位，委國事大臣。

translations.chinese: 王年少，初即位，委國事大臣。
translations.literal: The king was young and had just ascended the throne, so he entrusted state affairs to his ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The king was young and new to the throne, so he entrusted state affairs to his ministers.

context.previous: 蒙驁、王齮、麃公等為將軍。

translations.chinese: 晉陽反，元年，將軍蒙驁擊定之。
translations.literal: Jinyang rebelled. In the first year, General Meng Ao attacked and pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: Jinyang rebelled. In the first year, General Meng Ao attacked and brought it under control.

context.next: 二年，麃公將卒攻卷，斬首三萬。

translations.chinese: 二年，麃公將卒攻卷，斬首三萬。
translations.literal: In the second year, Bi Gong led troops to attack Juan and beheaded thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, General Bi Gong attacked Juan with his troops and beheaded thirty thousand.

context.previous: 晉陽反，元年，將軍蒙驁擊定之。
context.next: 三年，蒙驁攻韓，取十三城。

translations.chinese: 三年，蒙驁攻韓，取十三城。
translations.literal: In the third year, Meng Ao attacked Han and took thirteen cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Meng Ao attacked Han and captured thirteen cities.

context.previous: 二年，麃公將卒攻卷，斬首三萬。
context.next: 王齮死。

translations.chinese: 王齮死。
translations.literal: Wang Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qi died.

context.previous: 三年，蒙驁攻韓，取十三城。
context.next: 十月，將軍蒙驁攻魏氏暢、有詭。

translations.chinese: 十月，將軍蒙驁攻魏氏暢、有詭。
translations.literal: Tenth month, general Meng Ao attacked Wei's Chang, You Gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, General Meng Ao attacked Chang and Yougui of Wei.

context.previous: 王齮死。
context.next: 歲大饑。

translations.chinese: 歲大饑。
translations.literal: There was a great famine that year.
translations.idiomatic: There was a severe famine that year.

context.previous: 十月，將軍蒙驁攻魏氏暢、有詭。
context.next: 四年，拔暢、有詭。

translations.chinese: 四年，拔暢、有詭。
translations.literal: In the fourth year, they captured Chang and Yougui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, they captured Chang and Yougui.

context.previous: 歲大饑。
context.next: 三月，軍罷。

translations.chinese: 三月，軍罷。
translations.literal: In the third month, the army was disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the army was disbanded.

context.previous: 四年，拔暢、有詭。
context.next: 秦質子歸自趙，趙太子出歸國。

translations.chinese: 秦質子歸自趙，趙太子出歸國。
translations.literal: Qin's hostage returned from Zhao, and Zhao's crown prince went out and returned to his state.
translations.idiomatic: Qin's hostage returned from Zhao, and Zhao's crown prince departed to return to his state.

context.previous: 三月，軍罷。
context.next: 十月庚寅，蝗蟲從東方來，蔽天。

translations.chinese: 十月庚寅，蝗蟲從東方來，蔽天。
translations.literal: In the tenth month, on Gengyin day, locusts came from the east and covered the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on the Gengyin day, locusts came from the east and blotted out the sky.

context.previous: 秦質子歸自趙，趙太子出歸國。
context.next: 天下疫。

translations.chinese: 天下疫。
translations.literal: There was an epidemic throughout the world.
translations.idiomatic: There was an epidemic throughout the empire.

context.previous: 十月庚寅，蝗蟲從東方來，蔽天。
context.next: 百姓內粟千石，拜爵一級。

translations.chinese: 百姓內粟千石，拜爵一級。
translations.literal: Commoners who donated one thousand shi of grain were granted nobility one rank higher.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners who donated one thousand shi of grain were granted nobility one rank higher.

context.previous: 天下疫。
context.next: 五年，將軍驁攻魏，定酸棗、燕、虛、長平、雍丘、山陽城，皆拔之，取二十城。

translations.chinese: 五年，將軍驁攻魏，定酸棗、燕、虛、長平、雍丘、山陽城，皆拔之，取二十城。
translations.literal: In the fifth year, General Ao attacked Wei, pacified Suanzhao, Yan, Xu, Changping, Yongqiu, and Shanyang cities, captured them all, and took twenty cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, General Ao attacked Wei, bringing Suanzhao, Yan, Xu, Changping, Yongqiu, and Shanyang under control. He captured them all, taking twenty cities in total.

context.previous: 百姓內粟千石，拜爵一級。
context.next: 初置東郡。

translations.chinese: 初置東郡。
translations.literal: Dong commandery was initially established.
translations.idiomatic: Dong commandery was established for the first time.

context.previous: 五年，將軍驁攻魏，定酸棗、燕、虛、長平、雍丘、山陽城，皆拔之，取二十城。
context.next: 冬雷。

translations.chinese: 冬雷。
translations.literal: There was thunder in winter.
translations.idiomatic: There was thunder in winter.

context.previous: 初置東郡。
context.next: 六年，韓、魏、趙、衛、楚共擊秦，取壽陵。

translations.chinese: 六年，韓、魏、趙、衛、楚共擊秦，取壽陵。
translations.literal: In the sixth year, Han, Wei, Zhao, Wei, and Chu together attacked Qin and took Shouling.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Han, Wei, Zhao, Wei, and Chu joined forces to attack Qin and captured Shouling.

context.previous: 冬雷。
context.next: 秦出兵，五國兵罷。

translations.chinese: 秦出兵，五國兵罷。
translations.literal: Qin sent out troops, and the five states' armies disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: Qin sent out troops, and the five states' armies withdrew.

context.previous: 六年，韓、魏、趙、衛、楚共擊秦，取壽陵。
context.next: 拔衛，迫東郡，其君角率其支屬徙居野王，阻其山以保魏之河內。

translations.chinese: 拔衛，迫東郡，其君角率其支屬徙居野王，阻其山以保魏之河內。
translations.literal: Pulled Wei, pressed Dong commandery, its ruler Jiao led his branches relatives moved resided Ye Wang, blocked its mountains to preserve Wei's river inner.
translations.idiomatic: They captured Wei and pressed against Dong commandery. Its ruler Jiao led his clan and relatives to move and reside at Yewang, blocking the mountains to preserve Wei's Henan region.

context.previous: 秦出兵，五國兵罷。
context.next: 七年，彗星先出東方，見北方，五月見西方。

translations.chinese: 七年，彗星先出東方，見北方，五月見西方。
translations.literal: In the seventh year, a comet first appeared in the east, was seen in the north, and in the fifth month was seen in the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, a comet first appeared in the east, was visible in the north, and appeared in the west in the fifth month.

context.previous: 拔衛，迫東郡，其君角率其支屬徙居野王，阻其山以保魏之河內。
context.next: 將軍驁死。

translations.chinese: 將軍驁死。
translations.literal: General Ao died.
translations.idiomatic: General Ao died.

context.previous: 七年，彗星先出東方，見北方，五月見西方。
context.next: 以攻龍、孤、慶都，還兵攻汲。

translations.chinese: 以攻龍、孤、慶都，還兵攻汲。
translations.literal: After attacking Long, Gu, and Qingdu, they turned their troops back to attack Ji.
translations.idiomatic: After attacking Long, Gu, and Qingdu, they turned their troops back to attack Ji.

context.previous: 將軍驁死。
context.next: 彗星復見西方十六日。

translations.chinese: 彗星復見西方十六日。
translations.literal: The comet was seen again in the west for sixteen days.
translations.idiomatic: The comet reappeared in the west for sixteen days.

context.previous: 以攻龍、孤、慶都，還兵攻汲。
context.next: 夏太后死。

translations.chinese: 夏太后死。
translations.literal: Empress Dowager Xia died.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Xia died.

context.previous: 彗星復見西方十六日。
context.next: 八年，王弟長安君成蟜將軍擊趙，反，死屯留，軍吏皆斬死，遷其民於臨洮。

translations.chinese: 八年，王弟長安君成蟜將軍擊趙，反，死屯留，軍吏皆斬死，遷其民於臨洮。
translations.literal: Eighth year, king's younger brother Chang An Jun Cheng Juan general struck Zhao, rebelled, died Tun Liu, army officials all beheaded died, moved their people to Lin Tao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the king's younger brother Lord Chang'an Cheng Juan, serving as general, attacked Zhao but rebelled. He died at Tunliu, all the army officers were beheaded, and their people were moved to Lintao.

context.previous: 夏太后死。
context.next: 將軍壁死，卒屯留、蒲鶴反，戮其尸。

translations.chinese: 將軍壁死，卒屯留、蒲鶴反，戮其尸。
translations.literal: General Bi died, and the troops at Tunliu and Puhe rebelled. Their corpses were mutilated.
translations.idiomatic: General Bi died, and the troops at Tunliu and Puhe rebelled. Their corpses were mutilated.

context.previous: 八年，王弟長安君成蟜將軍擊趙，反，死屯留，軍吏皆斬死，遷其民於臨洮。
context.next: 河魚大上，輕車重馬東就食。

translations.chinese: 河魚大上，輕車重馬東就食。
translations.literal: River fish ascended in great numbers, and light chariots and heavy horses went east to seek food.
translations.idiomatic: Great numbers of river fish swam upstream, and light chariots and heavy horses went east in search of food.

context.previous: 將軍壁死，卒屯留、蒲鶴反，戮其尸。

translations.chinese: 嫪毐封為長信侯。
translations.literal: Lao Ai was enfeoffed as Lord Changxin.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Ai was enfeoffed as Lord Changxin.

context.next: 予之山陽地，令毐居之。

translations.chinese: 予之山陽地，令毐居之。
translations.literal: He was given Shanyang land and ordered to reside there.
translations.idiomatic: He was given Shanyang land and ordered to live there.

context.previous: 嫪毐封為長信侯。
context.next: 宮室車馬衣服苑囿馳獵恣毐。

translations.chinese: 宮室車馬衣服苑囿馳獵恣毐。
translations.literal: Palaces, chariots, horses, clothes, gardens, enclosures, galloping, and hunting—all were indulged for Ai.
translations.idiomatic: Palaces, chariots, horses, clothes, gardens, parks, galloping, and hunting—all were provided without limit for Ai.

context.previous: 予之山陽地，令毐居之。
context.next: 事無小大皆決於毐。

translations.chinese: 事無小大皆決於毐。
translations.literal: All matters, great or small, were decided by Ai.
translations.idiomatic: All matters, whether great or small, were decided by Ai.

context.previous: 宮室車馬衣服苑囿馳獵恣毐。
context.next: 又以河西太原郡更為毐國。

translations.chinese: 又以河西太原郡更為毐國。
translations.literal: The Hexi and Taiyuan commanderies were again changed to become Ai's state.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi and Taiyuan commanderies were once again changed to become Ai's domain.

context.previous: 事無小大皆決於毐。
context.next: 九年，彗星見，或竟天。

translations.chinese: 九年，彗星見，或竟天。
translations.literal: In the ninth year, a comet appeared, sometimes crossing the entire sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, a comet appeared, sometimes spanning the entire sky.

context.previous: 又以河西太原郡更為毐國。
context.next: 攻魏垣、蒲陽。

translations.chinese: 攻魏垣、蒲陽。
translations.literal: They attacked Wei's Yuan and Puyang.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Wei's Yuan and Puyang.

context.previous: 九年，彗星見，或竟天。
context.next: 四月，上宿雍。

translations.chinese: 四月，上宿雍。
translations.literal: In the fourth month, the emperor lodged at Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, His Majesty lodged at Yong.

context.previous: 攻魏垣、蒲陽。
context.next: 己酉，王冠，帶劍。

translations.chinese: 己酉，王冠，帶劍。
translations.literal: On Jiyou day, the king was crowned and belted with a sword.
translations.idiomatic: On the Jiyou day, the king was crowned and girded with a sword.

context.previous: 四月，上宿雍。
context.next: 長信侯毐作亂而覺，矯王御璽及太后璽以發縣卒及衛卒、官騎、戎翟君公、舍人，將欲攻蘄年宮為亂。

translations.chinese: 長信侯毐作亂而覺，矯王御璽及太后璽以發縣卒及衛卒、官騎、戎翟君公、舍人，將欲攻蘄年宮為亂。
translations.literal: Lord Changxin Lao Ai plotted rebellion and was discovered. He falsified the king's imperial seal and the empress dowager's seal to mobilize county troops, guard troops, official riders, Rongdi nobles, and attendants, intending to attack the Qinian Palace in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Changxin Lao Ai plotted rebellion and was discovered. He forged the king's imperial seal and the empress dowager's seal to mobilize county troops, guard troops, official cavalry, Rongdi nobles, and attendants, intending to attack the Qinian Palace in rebellion.

context.previous: 己酉，王冠，帶劍。
context.next: 王知之，令相國昌平君、昌文君發卒攻毐。

translations.chinese: 王知之，令相國昌平君、昌文君發卒攻毐。
translations.literal: The king learned of it and ordered the chancellor Lord Changping and Lord Changwen to send troops to attack Ai.
translations.idiomatic: The king learned of it and ordered Chancellor Lord Changping and Lord Changwen to dispatch troops to attack Ai.

context.previous: 長信侯毐作亂而覺，矯王御璽及太后璽以發縣卒及衛卒、官騎、戎翟君公、舍人，將欲攻蘄年宮為亂。
context.next: 戰咸陽，斬首數百，皆拜爵，及宦者皆在戰中，亦拜爵一級。

translations.chinese: 戰咸陽，斬首數百，皆拜爵，及宦者皆在戰中，亦拜爵一級。
translations.literal: They fought at Xianyang, beheaded several hundred, and all were granted nobility ranks. Even the eunuchs who were in the battle were also granted one nobility rank.
translations.idiomatic: They fought at Xianyang and beheaded several hundred. All participants were granted nobility ranks, and even the eunuchs who took part in the battle were granted one nobility rank.

context.previous: 王知之，令相國昌平君、昌文君發卒攻毐。
context.next: 毐等敗走。

translations.chinese: 毐等敗走。
translations.literal: Ai and his followers were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Ai and his followers were defeated and fled.

context.previous: 戰咸陽，斬首數百，皆拜爵，及宦者皆在戰中，亦拜爵一級。
context.next: 即令國中：有生得毐，賜錢百萬；

translations.chinese: 即令國中：有生得毐，賜錢百萬；
translations.literal: Immediately ordered state middle: who alive captures Ai, grants money one million;
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered throughout the state: Whoever captures Ai alive will be granted one million cash;

context.previous: 毐等敗走。
context.next: 殺之，五十萬。

translations.chinese: 殺之，五十萬。
translations.literal: whoever kills him, five hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever kills him will receive five hundred thousand.

context.previous: 即令國中：有生得毐，賜錢百萬；
context.next: 盡得毐等。

translations.chinese: 盡得毐等。
translations.literal: They completely captured Ai and his followers.
translations.idiomatic: They completely captured Ai and his followers.

context.previous: 殺之，五十萬。
context.next: 衛尉竭、內史肆、佐弋竭、中大夫令齊等二十人皆梟首。

translations.chinese: 衛尉竭、內史肆、佐弋竭、中大夫令齊等二十人皆梟首。
translations.literal: Wei Wei Jie, Nei Shi Si, Zuo Yi Jie, Zhong Da Fu Ling Qi, and twenty others all had their heads displayed on poles.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Wei Jie, Nei Shi Si, Zuo Yi Jie, Zhong Da Fu Ling Qi, and twenty others all had their heads displayed on poles.

context.previous: 盡得毐等。
context.next: 車裂以徇，滅其宗。

translations.chinese: 車裂以徇，滅其宗。
translations.literal: They were torn apart by chariots and displayed as a warning, and their clans were extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: They were torn apart by chariots as a public warning, and their clans were extinguished.

context.previous: 衛尉竭、內史肆、佐弋竭、中大夫令齊等二十人皆梟首。
context.next: 及其舍人，輕者為鬼薪。

translations.chinese: 及其舍人，輕者為鬼薪。
translations.literal: As for their attendants, the lesser ones were made to gather firewood for the ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: As for their attendants, the lesser ones were sentenced to gather firewood for the ghosts.

context.previous: 車裂以徇，滅其宗。
context.next: 及奪爵遷蜀四千餘家，家房陵。

translations.chinese: 及奪爵遷蜀四千餘家，家房陵。
translations.literal: They stripped them of nobility and moved over four thousand families to Shu, settling them at Fangling.
translations.idiomatic: They stripped the families of their nobility and relocated more than four thousand households to Shu, settling them at Fangling.

context.previous: 及其舍人，輕者為鬼薪。
context.next: （四）［是］月寒凍，有死者。

translations.chinese: （四）［是］月寒凍，有死者。
translations.literal: That month there was bitter cold, and some people died.
translations.idiomatic: That month brought bitter cold, and some people died.

context.previous: 及奪爵遷蜀四千餘家，家房陵。
context.next: 楊端和攻衍氏。

translations.chinese: 楊端和攻衍氏。
translations.literal: Yang Duan He attacked Yanshi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Duan He attacked Yanshi.

context.previous: （四）［是］月寒凍，有死者。
context.next: 彗星見西方，又見北方，從斗以南八十日。

translations.chinese: 彗星見西方，又見北方，從斗以南八十日。
translations.literal: A comet appeared in the west, then again in the north, extending south from the Dipper for eighty days.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared in the west, then reappeared in the north, stretching southward from the Dipper for eighty days.

context.previous: 楊端和攻衍氏。
context.next: 十年，相國呂不韋坐嫪毐免。

translations.chinese: 十年，相國呂不韋坐嫪毐免。
translations.literal: In the tenth year, Chancellor Lü Buwei was dismissed due to his connection with Lao Ai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Chancellor Lü Buwei was dismissed because of his involvement with Lao Ai.

context.previous: 彗星見西方，又見北方，從斗以南八十日。
context.next: 桓齮為將軍。

translations.chinese: 桓齮為將軍。
translations.literal: Huan Yi became general.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Yi became a general.

context.previous: 十年，相國呂不韋坐嫪毐免。
context.next: 齊、趙來置酒。

translations.chinese: 齊、趙來置酒。
translations.literal: Qi and Zhao came and held a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Qi and Zhao came and held a banquet.

context.previous: 桓齮為將軍。
context.next: 齊人茅焦說秦王曰：「秦方以天下為事，而大王有遷母太后之名，恐諸侯聞之，由此倍秦也。」

translations.chinese: 齊人茅焦說秦王曰：「秦方以天下為事，而大王有遷母太后之名，恐諸侯聞之，由此倍秦也。」
translations.literal: Qi person Mao Jiao persuaded Qin king said: 'Qin just with world as matter, yet great king has moved mother Tai Hou name, fear feudal lords hear it, thereby double Qin also.'
translations.idiomatic: The man from Qi, Mao Jiao, persuaded the King of Qin, saying, 'Qin is currently engaged with matters of the world, yet Your Majesty has the reputation of moving away your mother the Empress Dowager. I fear that if the feudal lords hear of this, they will thereby turn against Qin.'

context.previous: 齊、趙來置酒。
context.next: 秦王乃迎太后於雍而入咸陽，復居甘泉宮。

translations.chinese: 秦王乃迎太后於雍而入咸陽，復居甘泉宮。
translations.literal: The King of Qin then welcomed the Empress Dowager at Yong and brought her into Xianyang, where she again resided in the Ganquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Qin then went to Yong to welcome the Empress Dowager and brought her back to Xianyang, where she once again resided in the Ganquan Palace.

context.previous: 齊人茅焦說秦王曰：「秦方以天下為事，而大王有遷母太后之名，恐諸侯聞之，由此倍秦也。」

translations.chinese: 大索，逐客，李斯上書說，乃止逐客令。
translations.literal: There was a great search and expulsion of guests, but Li Si presented a memorial persuading the king, and the order to expel guests was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: A great search was conducted and guests were expelled, but Li Si presented a memorial persuading the king, and the order to expel guests was rescinded.

context.next: 李斯因說秦王，請先取韓以恐他國，於是使斯下韓。

translations.chinese: 李斯因說秦王，請先取韓以恐他國，於是使斯下韓。
translations.literal: Li Si therefore persuaded the King of Qin, requesting that they first take Han to frighten the other states. Thereupon he had Li Si go to Han.
translations.idiomatic: Li Si therefore persuaded the King of Qin, requesting that they first take Han to intimidate the other states. The king then sent Li Si to Han.

context.previous: 大索，逐客，李斯上書說，乃止逐客令。
context.next: 韓王患之。

translations.chinese: 韓王患之。
translations.literal: The King of Han was troubled by this.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Han was alarmed by this.

context.previous: 李斯因說秦王，請先取韓以恐他國，於是使斯下韓。
context.next: 與韓非謀弱秦。

translations.chinese: 與韓非謀弱秦。
translations.literal: He plotted with Han Fei to weaken Qin.
translations.idiomatic: He plotted with Han Fei to weaken Qin.

context.previous: 韓王患之。
context.next: 大梁人尉繚來，說秦王曰：「以秦之彊，諸侯譬如郡縣之君，臣但恐諸侯合從，翕而出不意，此乃智伯、夫差、湣王之所以亡也。

translations.chinese: 大梁人尉繚來，說秦王曰：「以秦之彊，諸侯譬如郡縣之君，臣但恐諸侯合從，翕而出不意，此乃智伯、夫差、湣王之所以亡也。
translations.literal: Da Liang person Wei Liao came, persuaded Qin king said: 'With Qin's strength, feudal lords like commandery county rulers, minister only fears feudal lords allied together, suddenly come out unexpectedly, this namely Zhi Bo, Fu Cha, Min Wang reason perished.'
translations.idiomatic: The man from Daliang, Wei Liao, came and persuaded the King of Qin, saying, 'With Qin's strength, the feudal lords are like the rulers of commanderies and counties. Your minister only fears that the feudal lords will ally together and suddenly come out unexpectedly—this is how Zhi Bo, Fu Cha, and King Min perished.'

context.previous: 與韓非謀弱秦。
context.next: 願大王毋愛財物，賂其豪臣，以亂其謀，不過亡三十萬金，則諸侯可盡。」

translations.chinese: 願大王毋愛財物，賂其豪臣，以亂其謀，不過亡三十萬金，則諸侯可盡。」
translations.literal: Wish great king not love wealth objects, bribe their powerful ministers, to disrupt their plans, no more lose three hundred thousand gold, then feudal lords can exhaust.'
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty would not begrudge wealth and valuables, but bribe their powerful ministers to disrupt their plans. It would cost no more than three hundred thousand in gold, and then the feudal lords could be exhausted.'

context.previous: 大梁人尉繚來，說秦王曰：「以秦之彊，諸侯譬如郡縣之君，臣但恐諸侯合從，翕而出不意，此乃智伯、夫差、湣王之所以亡也。
context.next: 秦王從其計，見尉繚亢禮，衣服食飲與繚同。

translations.chinese: 秦王從其計，見尉繚亢禮，衣服食飲與繚同。
translations.literal: The King of Qin followed his plan. He saw Wei Liao with proud ceremony, and his clothes, food, and drink were the same as Liao's.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Qin followed his plan. He received Wei Liao with great ceremony, and his clothes, food, and drink were the same as Liao's.

context.previous: 願大王毋愛財物，賂其豪臣，以亂其謀，不過亡三十萬金，則諸侯可盡。」
context.next: 繚曰：「秦王為人，蜂準，長目，摯鳥膺，豺聲，少恩而虎狼心，居約易出人下，得志亦輕食人。

translations.chinese: 繚曰：「秦王為人，蜂準，長目，摯鳥膺，豺聲，少恩而虎狼心，居約易出人下，得志亦輕食人。
translations.literal: Liao said: 'Qin king as person, bee nose, long eyes, determined bird breast, jackal voice, little kindness but tiger wolf heart, reside poverty easily comes out person below, obtains will also lightly eats person.
translations.idiomatic: Liao said, 'The King of Qin as a person has a nose like a bee's sting, long eyes, determined like a bird's breast, a jackal's voice, little kindness but a tiger and wolf heart. When in straitened circumstances he easily puts himself below others; when he obtains his will, he also lightly eats people.'

context.previous: 秦王從其計，見尉繚亢禮，衣服食飲與繚同。
context.next: 我布衣，然見我常身自下我。

translations.chinese: 我布衣，然見我常身自下我。
translations.literal: I am in commoner's clothes, yet when he sees me he often lowers his body himself beneath me.
translations.idiomatic: I wear commoner's clothes, yet when he sees me he always bows his body beneath mine.

context.previous: 繚曰：「秦王為人，蜂準，長目，摯鳥膺，豺聲，少恩而虎狼心，居約易出人下，得志亦輕食人。
context.next: 誠使秦王得志於天下，天下皆為虜矣。

translations.chinese: 誠使秦王得志於天下，天下皆為虜矣。
translations.literal: Truly make Qin king obtain will in world, world all become captives.'
translations.idiomatic: If the King of Qin truly obtains his will in the world, the world will all become his captives.'

context.previous: 我布衣，然見我常身自下我。
context.next: 不可與久游。」

translations.chinese: 不可與久游。」
translations.literal: Cannot with long travel.'
translations.idiomatic: One cannot travel with him for long.'

context.previous: 誠使秦王得志於天下，天下皆為虜矣。
context.next: 乃亡去。

translations.chinese: 乃亡去。
translations.literal: So he fled away.
translations.idiomatic: So he fled.

context.previous: 不可與久游。」
context.next: 秦王覺，固止，以為秦國尉，卒用其計策。

translations.chinese: 秦王覺，固止，以為秦國尉，卒用其計策。
translations.literal: The King of Qin became aware and firmly stopped him, making him Commandant of Qin, and in the end used his strategies.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Qin became aware and firmly detained him, appointing him Commandant of Qin, and eventually adopted his strategies.

context.previous: 乃亡去。
context.next: 而李斯用事。

translations.chinese: 而李斯用事。
translations.literal: And Li Si handled affairs.
translations.idiomatic: And Li Si took charge of affairs.

context.previous: 秦王覺，固止，以為秦國尉，卒用其計策。

translations.chinese: 十一年，王翦、桓齮、楊端和攻鄴，取九城。
translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Wang Jian, Huan Yi, and Yang Duan He attacked Ye and took nine cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Wang Jian, Huan Yi, and Yang Duan He attacked Ye and captured nine cities.

context.next: 王翦攻閼與、橑楊，皆并為一軍。

translations.chinese: 王翦攻閼與、橑楊，皆并為一軍。
translations.literal: Wang Jian attacked Eyu and Laoyang, and all were combined into one army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian attacked Eyu and Laoyang, and all were combined into one army.

context.previous: 十一年，王翦、桓齮、楊端和攻鄴，取九城。
context.next: 翦將十八日，軍歸斗食以下，什推二人從軍取鄴安陽，桓齮將。

translations.chinese: 翦將十八日，軍歸斗食以下，什推二人從軍取鄴安陽，桓齮將。
translations.literal: Jian was general for eighteen days. The army returned those of dou shi rank and below. One out of every ten pushed two persons to follow the army and take Ye and Anyang, with Huan Yi as general.
translations.idiomatic: Jian served as general for eighteen days. The army dismissed those of dou shi rank and below. One out of every ten pressed two persons to follow the army and take Ye and Anyang, with Huan Yi as general.

context.previous: 王翦攻閼與、橑楊，皆并為一軍。
context.next: 十二年，文信侯不韋死，竊葬。

translations.chinese: 十二年，文信侯不韋死，竊葬。
translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Lord Wenxin Bu Wei died and was buried in secret.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Lord Wenxin Lü Buwei died and was buried in secret.

context.previous: 翦將十八日，軍歸斗食以下，什推二人從軍取鄴安陽，桓齮將。
context.next: 其舍人臨者，晉人也逐出之；

translations.chinese: 其舍人臨者，晉人也逐出之；
translations.literal: His attendants attending ones, Jin people also drove out them;
translations.idiomatic: His attendants who attended the funeral, including Jin people, were also driven out;

context.previous: 十二年，文信侯不韋死，竊葬。
context.next: 秦人六百石以上奪爵，遷；

translations.chinese: 秦人六百石以上奪爵，遷；
translations.literal: Qin people six hundred shi above stripped nobility, moved;
translations.idiomatic: Qin people of six hundred shi rank and above were stripped of nobility and moved;

context.previous: 其舍人臨者，晉人也逐出之；
context.next: 五百石以下不臨，遷，勿奪爵。

translations.chinese: 五百石以下不臨，遷，勿奪爵。
translations.literal: Those of five hundred shi rank and below who did not attend were moved but not stripped of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Those of five hundred shi rank and below who did not attend were relocated but not stripped of their nobility.

context.previous: 秦人六百石以上奪爵，遷；
context.next: 自今以來，操國事不道如嫪毐、不韋者籍其門，視此。

translations.chinese: 自今以來，操國事不道如嫪毐、不韋者籍其門，視此。
translations.literal: From now on, those who handle state affairs improperly like Lao Ai and Bu Wei will have their gates registered—take this as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, those who handle state affairs improperly like Lao Ai and Lü Buwei will have their households registered—take this as a warning.

context.previous: 五百石以下不臨，遷，勿奪爵。
context.next: 秋，復嫪毐舍人遷蜀者。

translations.chinese: 秋，復嫪毐舍人遷蜀者。
translations.literal: In autumn, the attendants of Lao Ai who had been moved to Shu were moved again.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the attendants of Lao Ai who had been relocated to Shu were moved again.

context.previous: 自今以來，操國事不道如嫪毐、不韋者籍其門，視此。
context.next: 當是之時，天下大旱，六月至八月乃雨。

translations.chinese: 當是之時，天下大旱，六月至八月乃雨。
translations.literal: At this time, there was a great drought throughout the world. It did not rain from the sixth month until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, a great drought afflicted the empire. It did not rain from the sixth month until the eighth month.

context.previous: 秋，復嫪毐舍人遷蜀者。

translations.chinese: 十三年，桓齮攻趙平陽，殺趙將扈輒，斬首十萬。
translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Huan Yi attacked Zhao's Pingyang, killed the Zhao general Hu Zhe, and beheaded one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Huan Yi attacked Zhao's Pingyang, killed the Zhao general Hu Zhe, and beheaded one hundred thousand.

context.next: 王之河南。

translations.chinese: 王之河南。
translations.literal: The king went to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The king went to Henan.

context.previous: 十三年，桓齮攻趙平陽，殺趙將扈輒，斬首十萬。
context.next: 正月，彗星見東方。

translations.chinese: 正月，彗星見東方。
translations.literal: In the first month, a comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, a comet appeared in the east.

context.previous: 王之河南。
context.next: 十月，桓齮攻趙。

translations.chinese: 十月，桓齮攻趙。
translations.literal: In the tenth month, Huan Yi attacked Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Huan Yi attacked Zhao.

context.previous: 正月，彗星見東方。
context.next: 十四年，攻趙軍於平陽，取宜安，破之，殺其將軍。

translations.chinese: 十四年，攻趙軍於平陽，取宜安，破之，殺其將軍。
translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, they attacked the Zhao army at Pingyang, took Yian, broke it, and killed their general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, they attacked the Zhao army at Pingyang, captured Yian, routed it, and killed its general.

context.previous: 十月，桓齮攻趙。
context.next: 桓齮定平陽、武城。

translations.chinese: 桓齮定平陽、武城。
translations.literal: Huan Yi pacified Pingyang and Wucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Yi brought Pingyang and Wucheng under control.

context.previous: 十四年，攻趙軍於平陽，取宜安，破之，殺其將軍。
context.next: 韓非使秦，秦用李斯謀，留非，非死雲陽。

translations.chinese: 韓非使秦，秦用李斯謀，留非，非死雲陽。
translations.literal: Han Fei was sent to Qin. Qin used Li Si's plan, detained Fei, and Fei died at Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Han Fei was sent as an envoy to Qin. Qin followed Li Si's plan, detained Fei, and Fei died at Yunyang.

context.previous: 桓齮定平陽、武城。
context.next: 韓王請為臣。

translations.chinese: 韓王請為臣。
translations.literal: The King of Han requested to become a minister.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Han requested to become a vassal.

context.previous: 韓非使秦，秦用李斯謀，留非，非死雲陽。

translations.chinese: 十五年，大興兵，一軍至鄴，一軍至太原，取狼孟。
translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, they greatly raised troops—one army went to Ye, one army to Taiyuan, and they took Langmeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, they mobilized a large army—one force went to Ye, another to Taiyuan—and they captured Langmeng.

context.next: 地動。

translations.chinese: 地動。
translations.literal: There was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The earth shook.

context.previous: 十五年，大興兵，一軍至鄴，一軍至太原，取狼孟。
context.next: 十六年九月，發卒受地韓南陽假守騰。

translations.chinese: 十六年九月，發卒受地韓南陽假守騰。
translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, ninth month, they sent troops to receive the land of Han's Nanyang from the acting governor Teng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, ninth month, they dispatched troops to receive Han's Nanyang lands from the acting governor Teng.

context.previous: 地動。
context.next: 初令男子書年。

translations.chinese: 初令男子書年。
translations.literal: For the first time, they ordered men to register their ages.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time, they ordered men to register their ages.

context.previous: 十六年九月，發卒受地韓南陽假守騰。
context.next: 魏獻地於秦。

translations.chinese: 魏獻地於秦。
translations.literal: Wei offered land to Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Wei ceded land to Qin.

context.previous: 初令男子書年。
context.next: 秦置麗邑。

translations.chinese: 秦置麗邑。
translations.literal: Qin established Liyi.
translations.idiomatic: Qin established Liyi.

context.previous: 魏獻地於秦。
context.next: 十七年，內史騰攻韓，得韓王安，盡納其地，以其地為郡，命曰潁川。

translations.chinese: 十七年，內史騰攻韓，得韓王安，盡納其地，以其地為郡，命曰潁川。
translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the Chamberlain for the Capital Teng attacked Han, captured King An of Han, and completely took his lands, making them into a commandery named Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, Chamberlain for the Capital Teng attacked Han, captured King An of Han, and took all his lands, establishing them as a commandery named Yingchuan.

context.previous: 秦置麗邑。
context.next: 地動。

translations.chinese: 地動。
translations.literal: There was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The earth shook.

context.previous: 十七年，內史騰攻韓，得韓王安，盡納其地，以其地為郡，命曰潁川。
context.next: 華陽太后卒。

translations.chinese: 華陽太后卒。
translations.literal: Empress Dowager Huayang died.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Huayang died.

context.previous: 地動。
context.next: 民大饑。

translations.chinese: 民大饑。
translations.literal: There was a great famine among the people.
translations.idiomatic: A severe famine afflicted the people.

context.previous: 華陽太后卒。

translations.chinese: 十八年，大興兵攻趙，王翦將上地，下井陘，端和將河內，羌瘣伐趙，端和圍邯鄲城。
translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, they greatly raised troops to attack Zhao. Wang Jian commanded the upper lands and descended through Jingxing. Duan He commanded Henan. Qiang Wei attacked Zhao, and Duan He surrounded Handan city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, they mobilized a massive army to attack Zhao. Wang Jian commanded the highlands and descended through Jingxing Pass. Yang Duan He commanded Henan. Qiang Wei attacked Zhao, and Yang Duan He besieged Handan city.

context.next: 十九年，王翦、羌瘣盡定取趙地東陽，得趙王。

translations.chinese: 十九年，王翦、羌瘣盡定取趙地東陽，得趙王。
translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Wang Jian and Qiang Wei completely pacified and took the Dongyang lands of Zhao, and captured the King of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, Wang Jian and Qiang Wei completely subdued and took Zhao's Dongyang lands, capturing the King of Zhao.

translations.idiomatic: Commands are to be called 'decrees,' orders are to be called 'edicts,' and the Son of Heaven is to refer to himself as 'I.'

context.previous: 臣等昧死上尊號，王為『泰皇』。
context.next: 王曰：「去『泰』，著『皇』，采上古『帝』位號，號曰『皇帝』。

translations.chinese: 王曰：「去『泰』，著『皇』，采上古『帝』位號，號曰『皇帝』。
translations.literal: King said: 'Remove 'great', attach 'emperor', adopt high ancient 'emperor' position title, titled 'emperor'.
translations.idiomatic: The king said, 'Remove "great," attach "emperor." Adopt the high ancient "emperor" position title, and be titled "Emperor."'

context.previous: 命為『制』，令為『詔』，天子自稱曰『朕』。」
context.next: 他如議。」

translations.chinese: 他如議。」
translations.literal: Other as discussed.'
translations.idiomatic: For the rest, follow the discussion.'

context.previous: 王曰：「去『泰』，著『皇』，采上古『帝』位號，號曰『皇帝』。
context.next: 制曰：「可。」

translations.chinese: 制曰：「可。」
translations.literal: Decree said: 'Acceptable.'
translations.idiomatic: The decree said, 'Acceptable.'

context.previous: 他如議。」
context.next: 追尊莊襄王為太上皇。

translations.chinese: 追尊莊襄王為太上皇。
translations.literal: King Zhuangxiang was retroactively honored as the Supreme Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhuangxiang was retroactively honored as the Supreme Emperor.

context.previous: 制曰：「可。」
context.next: 制曰：「朕聞太古有號毋謚，中古有號，死而以行為謐。

translations.chinese: 制曰：「朕聞太古有號毋謚，中古有號，死而以行為謐。
translations.literal: Decree said: 'I heard high ancient had titles no posthumous names, middle ancient had titles, died and with conduct as posthumous names.
translations.idiomatic: The decree said, 'I have heard that in high antiquity there were titles but no posthumous names. In middle antiquity there were titles, and after death they took conduct as posthumous names.'

context.previous: 追尊莊襄王為太上皇。
context.next: 如此，則子議父，臣議君也，甚無謂，朕弗取焉。

translations.chinese: 如此，則子議父，臣議君也，甚無謂，朕弗取焉。
translations.literal: If it is like this, then sons would discuss fathers, ministers would discuss rulers. It is very meaningless; I will not take them.'
translations.idiomatic: If it is like this, then sons would discuss fathers, ministers would discuss rulers. It is very meaningless; I will not accept them.

context.previous: 制曰：「朕聞太古有號毋謚，中古有號，死而以行為謐。
context.next: 自今已來，除謚法。

translations.chinese: 自今已來，除謚法。
translations.literal: From now on, abolish the posthumous naming method.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, abolish the posthumous naming system.

context.previous: 如此，則子議父，臣議君也，甚無謂，朕弗取焉。
context.next: 朕為始皇帝。

translations.chinese: 朕為始皇帝。
translations.literal: I am the First Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: I am the First Emperor.

context.previous: 自今已來，除謚法。
context.next: 後世以計數，二世三世至于萬世，傳之無窮。」

translations.chinese: 後世以計數，二世三世至于萬世，傳之無窮。」
translations.literal: Later generations by counting, second generation third generation until ten thousand generations, transmit endlessly.'
translations.idiomatic: Later generations will count them: the Second Generation, Third Generation, until ten thousand generations, transmitting it endlessly.'

context.previous: 朕為始皇帝。

translations.chinese: 始皇推終始五德之傳，以為周得火德，秦代周德，從所不勝。
translations.literal: The First Emperor traced the transmission of the beginning and end of the Five Virtues, believing that Zhou received the fire virtue. Qin replaces Zhou's virtue, following what does not overcome it.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor traced the transmission of the Five Virtues from beginning to end, believing that Zhou received the fire virtue. Qin replaces Zhou's virtue, following what overcomes it.

context.next: 方今水德之始，改年始，朝賀皆自十月朔。

translations.chinese: 方今水德之始，改年始，朝賀皆自十月朔。
translations.literal: Just now is the beginning of the water virtue. Change the beginning of the year; court congratulations all begin from the first day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: The water virtue has just begun. Change the start of the year; all court congratulations should begin on the first day of the tenth month.

context.previous: 始皇推終始五德之傳，以為周得火德，秦代周德，從所不勝。
context.next: 衣服旄旌節旗皆上黑。

translations.chinese: 衣服旄旌節旗皆上黑。
translations.literal: Clothes, yak tails, banners, staffs, and flags all have black on top.
translations.idiomatic: Clothes, banners, staffs, and flags were all to be black.

context.previous: 方今水德之始，改年始，朝賀皆自十月朔。
context.next: 數以六為紀，符、法冠皆六寸，而輿六尺，六尺為步，乘六馬。

translations.chinese: 數以六為紀，符、法冠皆六寸，而輿六尺，六尺為步，乘六馬。
translations.literal: Numbers take six as the record. Tallies and law caps are all six inches. The carriage is six chi, six chi is a pace, and ride six horses.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers take six as the standard. Tallies and law caps are all six inches. The carriage is six chi, six chi equals a pace, and ride six horses.

context.previous: 衣服旄旌節旗皆上黑。
context.next: 更名河曰德水，以為水德之始。

translations.chinese: 更名河曰德水，以為水德之始。
translations.literal: Change the name of the river to Virtue Water, to be the beginning of the water virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Change the name of the Yellow River to Virtue Water, as the beginning of the water virtue.

context.previous: 數以六為紀，符、法冠皆六寸，而輿六尺，六尺為步，乘六馬。
context.next: 剛毅戾深，事皆決於法，刻削毋仁恩和義，然後合五德之數。

translations.chinese: 剛毅戾深，事皆決於法，刻削毋仁恩和義，然後合五德之數。
translations.literal: Be firm, resolute, fierce, and deep. Matters are all decided by law, harsh and strict without benevolence, kindness, harmony, or righteousness. Only then does it match the number of the Five Virtues.
translations.idiomatic: Be firm, resolute, fierce, and profound. All matters are decided by law—harsh and strict without benevolence, kindness, harmony, or righteousness. Only then does it match the number of the Five Virtues.

context.previous: 更名河曰德水，以為水德之始。
context.next: 於是急法，久者不赦。

translations.chinese: 於是急法，久者不赦。
translations.literal: Thereupon the laws were made urgent; long-standing cases were not pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the laws were made strict; long-standing cases were not pardoned.

context.previous: 剛毅戾深，事皆決於法，刻削毋仁恩和義，然後合五德之數。

translations.chinese: 丞相綰等言：「諸侯初破，燕、齊、荊地遠，不為置王，毋以填之。
translations.literal: Chancellor Wan etc. spoke: 'Feudal lords just broken, Yan, Qi, Jing lands far, not for establish kings, not with fill them.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Wan and others said, 'The feudal lords have just been broken. Yan, Qi, and Jing lands are far away. If we do not establish kings for them, there is nothing with which to fill them.'

context.next: 請立諸子，唯上幸許。」

translations.chinese: 請立諸子，唯上幸許。」
translations.literal: Request establish various sons, only Your Majesty fortunate permit.'
translations.idiomatic: We request to establish various sons as kings. May Your Majesty fortunately permit it.'

context.previous: 丞相綰等言：「諸侯初破，燕、齊、荊地遠，不為置王，毋以填之。
context.next: 始皇下其議於群臣，群臣皆以為便。

translations.chinese: 始皇下其議於群臣，群臣皆以為便。
translations.literal: The First Emperor sent their discussion down to the ministers, and all the ministers thought it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor sent the discussion down to his ministers, and all the ministers considered it appropriate.

context.previous: 請立諸子，唯上幸許。」
context.next: 廷尉李斯議曰：「周文武所封子弟同姓甚眾，然後屬疏遠，相攻擊如仇讎，諸侯更相誅伐，周天子弗能禁止。

translations.chinese: 廷尉李斯議曰：「周文武所封子弟同姓甚眾，然後屬疏遠，相攻擊如仇讎，諸侯更相誅伐，周天子弗能禁止。
translations.literal: Court judge Li Si discussed said: 'Zhou Wen Wu what enfeoffed sons younger brothers same surname very many, then connections distant, mutually attacked like enemies, feudal lords mutually executed attacked, Zhou Son of Heaven not able prohibit.
translations.idiomatic: Court Judge Li Si discussed and said, 'The sons and younger brothers of the same surname that Zhou Wen and Wu enfeoffed were very many. Then their connections became distant, they attacked each other like enemies, the feudal lords mutually executed and attacked each other, and the Zhou Son of Heaven was not able to prohibit it.'

context.previous: 始皇下其議於群臣，群臣皆以為便。
context.next: 今海內賴陛下神靈一統，皆為郡縣，諸子功臣以公賦稅重賞賜之，甚足易制。

translations.chinese: 今海內賴陛下神靈一統，皆為郡縣，諸子功臣以公賦稅重賞賜之，甚足易制。
translations.literal: Now within the seas, relying on Your Majesty's divine spirit for unification, all are commanderies and counties. The various sons and meritorious ministers are heavily rewarded and granted from the public taxes. It is very sufficient and easy to control.'
translations.idiomatic: Now within the seas, relying on Your Majesty's divine spirit for unification, all are commanderies and counties. The various sons and meritorious ministers are heavily rewarded from the public taxes. It is very sufficient and easy to control.'

context.previous: 廷尉李斯議曰：「周文武所封子弟同姓甚眾，然後屬疏遠，相攻擊如仇讎，諸侯更相誅伐，周天子弗能禁止。
context.next: 天下無異意，則安寧之術也。

translations.chinese: 天下無異意，則安寧之術也。
translations.literal: If the world has no different intentions, then this is the method of peace and tranquility.'
translations.idiomatic: If the world has no dissenting intentions, then this is the method of peace and tranquility.'

context.previous: 今海內賴陛下神靈一統，皆為郡縣，諸子功臣以公賦稅重賞賜之，甚足易制。
context.next: 置諸侯不便。」

translations.chinese: 置諸侯不便。」
translations.literal: Establish feudal lords inconvenient.'
translations.idiomatic: Establishing feudal lords is inconvenient.'

context.previous: 天下無異意，則安寧之術也。
context.next: 始皇曰：「天下共苦戰鬬不休，以有侯王。

translations.chinese: 始皇曰：「天下共苦戰鬬不休，以有侯王。
translations.literal: Beginning emperor said: 'World together suffers battle struggle not stops, because has hou kings.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor said, 'The world together suffers from unending battle and struggle, because there are hou and kings.'

context.previous: 置諸侯不便。」
context.next: 賴宗廟，天下初定，又復立國，是樹兵也，而求其寧息，豈不難哉！

translations.chinese: 賴宗廟，天下初定，又復立國，是樹兵也，而求其寧息，豈不難哉！
translations.literal: Rely ancestral temple, world just settled, again establish states, this plants soldiers also, yet seek its peace rest, how not difficult!
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the ancestral temples, the world has just been settled, yet to establish states again—this is planting soldiers, and yet to seek its peace and rest, how can it not be difficult!'

context.previous: 始皇曰：「天下共苦戰鬬不休，以有侯王。
context.next: 廷尉議是。」

translations.chinese: 廷尉議是。」
translations.literal: Court judge discusses this.'
translations.idiomatic: The Court Judge's discussion is correct.'

context.previous: 賴宗廟，天下初定，又復立國，是樹兵也，而求其寧息，豈不難哉！

translations.chinese: 分天下以為三十六郡，郡置守、尉、監。
translations.literal: The world was divided into thirty-six commanderies. Each commandery established a governor, a commandery lieutenant, and a supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: The world was divided into thirty-six commanderies. Each commandery established a governor, a commandery lieutenant, and a supervisor.

context.next: 更名民曰「黔首」。

translations.chinese: 更名民曰「黔首」。
translations.literal: Change name people called 'qian shou'.
translations.idiomatic: The name of the people was changed to 'Qianshou.'

context.previous: 分天下以為三十六郡，郡置守、尉、監。
context.next: 大酺。

translations.chinese: 大酺。
translations.literal: There was a great celebration.
translations.idiomatic: There was a great celebration.

context.previous: 更名民曰「黔首」。
context.next: 收天下兵，聚之咸陽，銷以為鐘鐻，金人十二，重各千石，置廷宮中。

translations.chinese: 收天下兵，聚之咸陽，銷以為鐘鐻，金人十二，重各千石，置廷宮中。
translations.literal: Weapons from throughout the world were collected and gathered at Xianyang. They were melted to make bells and jian. Twelve golden statues were made, each weighing a thousand shi, and placed in the court palace.
translations.idiomatic: Weapons from throughout the world were collected and gathered at Xianyang. They were melted down to make bells and chimes. Twelve golden statues were made, each weighing a thousand shi, and placed in the court palace.

context.previous: 大酺。
context.next: 一法度衡石丈尺。

translations.chinese: 一法度衡石丈尺。
translations.literal: Laws, measures, balances, stones, zhang, and chi were standardized.
translations.idiomatic: Laws, measures, balances, stones, zhang, and chi were unified.

context.previous: 收天下兵，聚之咸陽，銷以為鐘鐻，金人十二，重各千石，置廷宮中。
context.next: 車同軌。

translations.chinese: 車同軌。
translations.literal: Chariots had the same track width.
translations.idiomatic: Chariots followed the same track width.

context.previous: 一法度衡石丈尺。
context.next: 書同文字。

translations.chinese: 書同文字。
translations.literal: Writing used the same characters.
translations.idiomatic: Writing used the same characters.

context.previous: 車同軌。
context.next: 地東至海暨朝鮮，西至臨洮、羌中，南至北向戶，北據河為塞，并陰山至遼東。

translations.chinese: 地東至海暨朝鮮，西至臨洮、羌中，南至北向戶，北據河為塞，并陰山至遼東。
translations.literal: The lands extended east to the sea and Chaoxian, west to Lintao and Qiangzhong, south to Beixianghu, north took the river as a barrier, and extended along the Yin Mountains to Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: The empire extended east to the sea and Chaoxian, west to Lintao and Qiangzhong, south to Beixianghu. To the north it took the Yellow River as its barrier, extending along the Yin Mountains to Liaodong.

context.previous: 書同文字。
context.next: 徙天下豪富於咸陽十二萬戶。

translations.chinese: 徙天下豪富於咸陽十二萬戶。
translations.literal: One hundred twenty thousand households of the world's powerful and rich were moved to Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty thousand households of the empire's powerful and wealthy were relocated to Xianyang.

context.previous: 地東至海暨朝鮮，西至臨洮、羌中，南至北向戶，北據河為塞，并陰山至遼東。
context.next: 諸廟及章臺、上林皆在渭南。

translations.chinese: 諸廟及章臺、上林皆在渭南。
translations.literal: The various temples, Zhangtai, and Shanglin were all located south of the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: The various temples, Zhangtai, and Shanglin were all located south of the Wei River.

context.previous: 徙天下豪富於咸陽十二萬戶。
context.next: 秦每破諸侯，寫放其宮室，作之咸陽北阪上，南臨渭，自雍門以東至涇、渭，殿屋複道周閣相屬。

translations.chinese: 秦每破諸侯，寫放其宮室，作之咸陽北阪上，南臨渭，自雍門以東至涇、渭，殿屋複道周閣相屬。
translations.literal: Each time Qin broke a feudal lord, they copied and modeled their palaces and chambers, building them on the northern slope of Xianyang, facing south toward the Wei. From Yong Gate eastward to the Jing and Wei, hall houses, covered ways, and winding pavilions were connected together.
translations.idiomatic: Each time Qin defeated a feudal lord, they copied and modeled their palaces and chambers, building them on the northern slope of Xianyang, facing south toward the Wei. From Yong Gate eastward to the Jing and Wei rivers, hall houses, covered walkways, and winding pavilions were connected together.

context.previous: 諸廟及章臺、上林皆在渭南。
context.next: 所得諸侯美人鐘鼓，以充入之。

translations.chinese: 所得諸侯美人鐘鼓，以充入之。
translations.literal: The beauties, bells, and drums obtained from the feudal lords were used to fill and enter them.
translations.idiomatic: The beauties, bells, and drums obtained from the feudal lords were used to fill and adorn them.

context.previous: 秦每破諸侯，寫放其宮室，作之咸陽北阪上，南臨渭，自雍門以東至涇、渭，殿屋複道周閣相屬。

translations.chinese: 二十七年，始皇巡隴西、北地，出雞頭山，過回中。
translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the First Emperor toured Longxi and Beidi, came out at Jitou Mountain, and passed through Huizhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, the First Emperor toured Longxi and Beidi, emerged at Jitou Mountain, and passed through Huizhong.

context.next: 焉作信宮渭南，已更命信宮為極廟，象天極。

translations.chinese: 焉作信宮渭南，已更命信宮為極廟，象天極。
translations.literal: There he built the Xin Palace south of the Wei. He then changed the name of the Xin Palace to Ji Temple, imitating the extreme of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: There he built the Xin Palace south of the Wei. He then renamed the Xin Palace as Ji Temple, imitating the pole of heaven.

context.previous: 二十七年，始皇巡隴西、北地，出雞頭山，過回中。
context.next: 自極廟道通酈山，作甘泉前殿。

translations.chinese: 自極廟道通酈山，作甘泉前殿。
translations.literal: A road from the Ji Temple connected to Li Mountain, and the Ganquan Front Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: A road was built from the Ji Temple connecting to Li Mountain, and the Ganquan Front Hall was constructed.

context.previous: 焉作信宮渭南，已更命信宮為極廟，象天極。
context.next: 筑甬道，自咸陽屬之。

translations.chinese: 筑甬道，自咸陽屬之。
translations.literal: A covered way was built connecting it from Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: A covered walkway was built connecting it from Xianyang.

context.previous: 自極廟道通酈山，作甘泉前殿。
context.next: 是歲，賜爵一級。

translations.chinese: 是歲，賜爵一級。
translations.literal: That year, nobility ranks were granted one level higher.
translations.idiomatic: That year, nobility ranks were granted one level higher.

context.previous: 筑甬道，自咸陽屬之。
context.next: 治馳道。

translations.chinese: 治馳道。
translations.literal: Gallop roads were administered.
translations.idiomatic: Gallop roads were maintained.

context.previous: 是歲，賜爵一級。

translations.chinese: 二十八年，始皇東行郡縣，上鄒嶧山。
translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the First Emperor traveled east through the commanderies and counties, and ascended Zouyishan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, the First Emperor traveled east through the commanderies and counties, ascending Zouyishan.

context.next: 立石，與魯諸儒生議，刻石頌秦德，議封禪望祭山川之事。

translations.chinese: 立石，與魯諸儒生議，刻石頌秦德，議封禪望祭山川之事。
translations.literal: He erected a stone and discussed with the various scholars from Lu. He carved on the stone to praise Qin's virtue, and discussed the matters of feng and shan sacrifices, hoping to sacrifice to the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He erected a stone and discussed with various scholars from Lu. He carved on the stone to praise Qin's virtue, and discussed the matters of feng and shan sacrifices to offer sacrifices to the mountains and rivers.

context.previous: 二十八年，始皇東行郡縣，上鄒嶧山。
context.next: 乃遂上泰山，立石，封，祠祀。

translations.chinese: 乃遂上泰山，立石，封，祠祀。
translations.literal: He then ascended Mount Tai, erected a stone, performed the feng sacrifice, and made sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: He then ascended Mount Tai, erected a stone, performed the feng sacrifice, and offered sacrificial rites.

context.previous: 立石，與魯諸儒生議，刻石頌秦德，議封禪望祭山川之事。
context.next: 下，風雨暴至，休於樹下，因封其樹為五大夫。

translations.chinese: 下，風雨暴至，休於樹下，因封其樹為五大夫。
translations.literal: As he descended, violent wind and rain arrived. He rested under a tree, and therefore enfeoffed the tree as a Five Great Man.
translations.idiomatic: As he descended, violent wind and rain arrived. He rested under a tree, and therefore enfeoffed the tree as a Five Great Man.

context.previous: 乃遂上泰山，立石，封，祠祀。
context.next: 禪梁父。

translations.chinese: 禪梁父。
translations.literal: He performed the shan sacrifice at Liangfu.
translations.idiomatic: He performed the shan sacrifice at Liangfu.

context.previous: 下，風雨暴至，休於樹下，因封其樹為五大夫。
context.next: 刻所立石，其辭曰：

translations.chinese: 刻所立石，其辭曰：
translations.literal: Carved erected stone, its words said:
translations.idiomatic: He carved on the erected stone, and its words said:

context.previous: 禪梁父。

translations.chinese: 皇帝臨位，作制明法，臣下修飭。
translations.literal: The Emperor assumes the position, establishes systems and clarifies laws; the ministers below repair their conduct.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor assumes his position, establishes systems and clarifies laws; the ministers below mend their conduct.

translations.chinese: 昭明宗廟，體道行德，尊號大成。
translations.literal: He brightens and clarifies the ancestral temples, embodies the way and practices virtue; the honored title is greatly completed.'
translations.idiomatic: He brightens and clarifies the ancestral temples, embodies the way and practices virtue; the honored title is greatly completed.'

context.previous: 今皇帝并一海內，以為郡縣，天下和平。
context.next: 群臣相與誦皇帝功德，刻于金石，以為表經。」

translations.chinese: 群臣相與誦皇帝功德，刻于金石，以為表經。」
translations.literal: Ministers mutually recite emperor merit virtue, carve on metal stone, to be standard classic.'
translations.idiomatic: The ministers mutually recite the Emperor's merit and virtue, carve it on metal and stone, to be the standard classic.'

context.previous: 昭明宗廟，體道行德，尊號大成。

translations.chinese: 既已，齊人徐市等上書，言海中有三神山，名曰蓬萊、方丈、瀛洲，僊人居之。
translations.literal: Having done this, the Qi man Xu Shi and others presented a memorial saying that in the sea there are three divine mountains, named Penglai, Fangzhang, and Yingzhou, where immortals dwell.
translations.idiomatic: Having done this, the Qi man Xu Shi and others presented a memorial saying that in the sea there are three divine mountains, named Penglai, Fangzhang, and Yingzhou, where immortals dwell.

context.next: 請得齋戒，與童男女求之。

translations.chinese: 請得齋戒，與童男女求之。
translations.literal: They requested to obtain fasting and purification, and seek them with virgin boys and girls.
translations.idiomatic: They requested to obtain fasting and purification, and seek them with virgin boys and girls.

context.previous: 既已，齊人徐市等上書，言海中有三神山，名曰蓬萊、方丈、瀛洲，僊人居之。
context.next: 於是遣徐市發童男女數千人，入海求僊人。

translations.chinese: 於是遣徐市發童男女數千人，入海求僊人。
translations.literal: Thereupon he dispatched Xu Shi to send several thousand virgin boys and girls to enter the sea and seek the immortals.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he dispatched Xu Shi to send several thousand virgin boys and girls to enter the sea and seek the immortals.

context.previous: 請得齋戒，與童男女求之。

translations.chinese: 始皇還，過彭城，齋戒禱祠，欲出周鼎泗水。
translations.literal: The First Emperor returned, passed through Pengcheng, fasted and purified, prayed and sacrificed, wishing to bring out the Zhou tripod from the Si River.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor returned, passed through Pengcheng, fasted and purified, prayed and sacrificed, wishing to bring out the Zhou tripod from the Si River.

context.next: 使千人沒水求之，弗得。

translations.chinese: 使千人沒水求之，弗得。
translations.literal: He made a thousand people dive into the water to seek it, but they did not obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: He made a thousand people dive into the water to seek it, but they did not obtain it.

context.previous: 始皇還，過彭城，齋戒禱祠，欲出周鼎泗水。
context.next: 乃西南渡淮水，之衡山、南郡。

translations.chinese: 乃西南渡淮水，之衡山、南郡。
translations.literal: He then crossed the Huai River to the southwest, going to Mount Heng and Nang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He then crossed the Huai River to the southwest, going to Mount Heng and Nang commandery.

context.previous: 使千人沒水求之，弗得。
context.next: 浮江，至湘山祠。

translations.chinese: 浮江，至湘山祠。
translations.literal: He floated down the Jiang and reached Mount Xiang to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: He floated down the Jiang and reached Mount Xiang to sacrifice.

context.previous: 乃西南渡淮水，之衡山、南郡。
context.next: 逢大風，幾不得渡。

translations.chinese: 逢大風，幾不得渡。
translations.literal: He encountered a great wind and almost could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: He encountered a great wind and almost could not cross.

context.previous: 浮江，至湘山祠。
context.next: 上問博士曰：「湘君神？」

translations.chinese: 上問博士曰：「湘君神？」
translations.literal: His Majesty asked scholars said: 'Xiang jun spirit?'
translations.idiomatic: His Majesty asked the scholars, 'Is it the Xiangjun spirit?'

context.previous: 逢大風，幾不得渡。
context.next: 博士對曰：「聞之，堯女，舜之妻，而葬此。」

translations.chinese: 博士對曰：「聞之，堯女，舜之妻，而葬此。」
translations.literal: Scholars answered said: 'Heard it, Yao female, Shun of wife, and buried here.'
translations.idiomatic: The scholars answered, 'We have heard that it is Yao's daughter, Shun's wife, who is buried here.'

context.previous: 上問博士曰：「湘君神？」
context.next: 於是始皇大怒，使刑徒三千人皆伐湘山樹，赭其山。

translations.chinese: 於是始皇大怒，使刑徒三千人皆伐湘山樹，赭其山。
translations.literal: Thereupon the First Emperor was greatly angered and made three thousand criminals all cut down the trees on Mount Xiang, reddening the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the First Emperor was greatly angered and made three thousand criminals all cut down the trees on Mount Xiang, reddening the mountain.

context.previous: 博士對曰：「聞之，堯女，舜之妻，而葬此。」
context.next: 上自南郡由武關歸。

translations.chinese: 上自南郡由武關歸。
translations.literal: His Majesty returned from Nang commandery by way of Wu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: His Majesty returned from Nang commandery by way of Wu Pass.

context.previous: 於是始皇大怒，使刑徒三千人皆伐湘山樹，赭其山。

translations.chinese: 二十九年，始皇東游。
translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the First Emperor toured to the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, the First Emperor toured to the east.

context.next: 至陽武博狼沙中，為盜所驚。

translations.chinese: 至陽武博狼沙中，為盜所驚。
translations.literal: He reached Yangwu in the midst of Bolangsha, where he was startled by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He reached Yangwu in the midst of Bolangsha, where he was startled by bandits.

context.previous: 二十九年，始皇東游。
context.next: 求弗得，乃令天下大索十日。

translations.chinese: 求弗得，乃令天下大索十日。
translations.literal: They sought but did not obtain them, so he ordered a great search throughout the world for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: They sought but did not obtain them, so he ordered a great search throughout the world for ten days.

context.previous: 至陽武博狼沙中，為盜所驚。

translations.chinese: 登之罘，刻石。
translations.literal: He ascended Zhifu and carved on stone.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended Zhifu and carved on stone.

context.next: 其辭曰：

translations.chinese: 其辭曰：
translations.literal: Its words said:
translations.idiomatic: Its words said:

context.previous: 登之罘，刻石。

translations.chinese: 維二十九年，時在中春，陽和方起。
translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, at the time of mid-spring, yang harmony has just arisen.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, at the time of mid-spring, yang harmony has just arisen.

context.next: 皇帝東游，巡登之罘，臨照于海。

translations.chinese: 皇帝東游，巡登之罘，臨照于海。
translations.literal: The Emperor tours to the east, patrols and ascends Zhifu, overlooks and is illuminated by the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor tours to the east, patrols and ascends Zhifu, overlooks and is illuminated by the sea.

context.previous: 維二十九年，時在中春，陽和方起。
context.next: 從臣嘉觀，原念休烈，追誦本始。

translations.chinese: 從臣嘉觀，原念休烈，追誦本始。
translations.literal: The attendant ministers admire the view, trace and think of the auspicious achievements, pursue and recite the origins and beginning.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant ministers admire the view, trace and think of the auspicious achievements, pursue and recite the origins and beginning.

context.previous: 皇帝東游，巡登之罘，臨照于海。
context.next: 大聖作治，建定法度，顯箸綱紀。

translations.chinese: 大聖作治，建定法度，顯箸綱紀。
translations.literal: The great sage makes governance, establishes and determines laws and measures, manifests and displays the outlines and order.
translations.idiomatic: The great sage makes governance, establishes and determines laws and measures, manifests and displays the outlines and order.

context.previous: 從臣嘉觀，原念休烈，追誦本始。
context.next: 外教諸侯，光施文惠，明以義理。

translations.chinese: 外教諸侯，光施文惠，明以義理。
translations.literal: Outwardly he teaches the feudal lords, brightly bestows cultured benevolence, clarifies with righteousness and principle.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly he teaches the feudal lords, brightly bestows cultured benevolence, clarifies with righteousness and principle.

context.previous: 大聖作治，建定法度，顯箸綱紀。
context.next: 六國回辟，貪戾無厭，虐殺不已。

translations.chinese: 六國回辟，貪戾無厭，虐殺不已。
translations.literal: The six states are rebellious and evil, greedy and ferocious without satisfaction, cruelly killing without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: The six states are rebellious and evil, greedy and ferocious without satisfaction, cruelly killing without stopping.

context.previous: 外教諸侯，光施文惠，明以義理。
context.next: 皇帝哀眾，遂發討師，奮揚武德。

translations.chinese: 皇帝哀眾，遂發討師，奮揚武德。
translations.literal: The Emperor pities the multitude, then sends a punitive army, arouses and raises martial virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pities the multitude, then sends a punitive army, arouses and raises martial virtue.

context.previous: 六國回辟，貪戾無厭，虐殺不已。
context.next: 義誅信行，威燀旁達，莫不賓服。

translations.chinese: 義誅信行，威燀旁達，莫不賓服。
translations.literal: Righteous executions are carried out trustworthily, awe and splendor broadly reach, none do not submit and obey.
translations.idiomatic: Righteous executions are carried out trustworthily, awe and splendor broadly reach, none do not submit and obey.

context.previous: 皇帝哀眾，遂發討師，奮揚武德。
context.next: 烹滅彊暴，振救黔首，周定四極。

translations.chinese: 烹滅彊暴，振救黔首，周定四極。
translations.literal: He boils and extinguishes the strong and violent, shakes and saves the qianshou, comprehensively determines the four extremes.
translations.idiomatic: He boils and extinguishes the strong and violent, shakes and saves the commoners, comprehensively determines the four extremes.

context.previous: 義誅信行，威燀旁達，莫不賓服。
context.next: 普施明法，經緯天下，永為儀則。

translations.chinese: 普施明法，經緯天下，永為儀則。
translations.literal: He universally bestows clear laws, warps and wefts the world, eternally as the model and standard.
translations.idiomatic: He universally bestows clear laws, orders the world, eternally as the model and standard.

context.previous: 烹滅彊暴，振救黔首，周定四極。
context.next: 大矣哉！

translations.chinese: 大矣哉！
translations.literal: Great indeed!
translations.idiomatic: How great indeed!

context.previous: 普施明法，經緯天下，永為儀則。
context.next: 宇縣之中，承順聖意。

translations.chinese: 宇縣之中，承順聖意。
translations.literal: Within the universe and prefectures, they receive and obey the holy intention.
translations.idiomatic: Within the universe and prefectures, they receive and obey the holy intention.

context.previous: 大矣哉！
context.next: 群臣誦功，請刻于石，表垂于常式。

translations.chinese: 群臣誦功，請刻于石，表垂于常式。
translations.literal: The ministers recite the merit, request it carved on stone, tablet hung on the constant form.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers recite the merit, request it carved on stone, tablet hung on the constant form.

context.previous: 宇縣之中，承順聖意。

translations.chinese: 其東觀曰：二十九年，皇帝春游，覽省遠方。
translations.literal: Its east view said: twenty-ninth year, emperor spring toured, viewed inspected distant places.
translations.idiomatic: Its eastern view says: In the twenty-ninth year, the Emperor tours in spring, views and inspects distant places.

context.next: 逮于海隅，遂登之罘，昭臨朝陽。

translations.chinese: 逮于海隅，遂登之罘，昭臨朝陽。
translations.literal: He reaches to the sea corner, then ascends Zhifu, brightly approaches the morning sun.
translations.idiomatic: He reaches to the sea corner, then ascends Zhifu, brightly approaches the morning sun.

context.previous: 其東觀曰：二十九年，皇帝春游，覽省遠方。
context.next: 觀望廣麗，從臣咸念，原道至明。

translations.chinese: 觀望廣麗，從臣咸念，原道至明。
translations.literal: They view and gaze at the broad and beautiful; the attendant ministers all think, trace the way to utmost clarity.
translations.idiomatic: They view and gaze at the broad and beautiful; the attendant ministers all think, trace the way to utmost clarity.

context.previous: 逮于海隅，遂登之罘，昭臨朝陽。
context.next: 聖法初興，清理疆內，外誅暴彊。

translations.chinese: 聖法初興，清理疆內，外誅暴彊。
translations.literal: Holy laws initially arose, cleared and purified within the borders, outward executed the violent and strong.
translations.idiomatic: Holy laws initially arose, cleared and purified within the borders, outward executed the violent and strong.

context.previous: 觀望廣麗，從臣咸念，原道至明。
context.next: 武威旁暢，振動四極，禽滅六王。

translations.chinese: 武威旁暢，振動四極，禽滅六王。
translations.literal: Martial might broadly spreads, shakes and moves the four extremes, captures and extinguishes the six kings.
translations.idiomatic: Martial might broadly spreads, shakes and moves the four extremes, captures and extinguishes the six kings.

context.previous: 聖法初興，清理疆內，外誅暴彊。
context.next: 闡并天下，甾害絕息，永偃戎兵。

translations.chinese: 闡并天下，甾害絕息，永偃戎兵。
translations.literal: He clarifies and unites the world; harm and injury absolutely cease; eternally lays aside weapons and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He clarifies and unites the world; harm and injury absolutely cease; eternally lays aside weapons and soldiers.

context.previous: 武威旁暢，振動四極，禽滅六王。
context.next: 皇帝明德，經理宇內，視聽不怠。

translations.chinese: 皇帝明德，經理宇內，視聽不怠。
translations.literal: The Emperor's bright virtue manages and regulates within the universe; sight and hearing are not slack.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's bright virtue manages and regulates within the universe; sight and hearing are not slack.

context.previous: 闡并天下，甾害絕息，永偃戎兵。
context.next: 作立大義，昭設備器，咸有章旗。

translations.chinese: 作立大義，昭設備器，咸有章旗。
translations.literal: He makes and establishes great righteousness, brightly prepares equipment and instruments, all have chapter and banners.
translations.idiomatic: He makes and establishes great righteousness, brightly prepares equipment and instruments, all have chapter and banners.

context.previous: 皇帝明德，經理宇內，視聽不怠。
context.next: 職臣遵分，各知所行，事無嫌疑。

translations.chinese: 職臣遵分，各知所行，事無嫌疑。
translations.literal: Office ministers comply with divisions, each knows what to carry out, matters without suspicion or doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Office ministers comply with divisions, each knows what to carry out, matters without suspicion or doubt.

context.previous: 作立大義，昭設備器，咸有章旗。
context.next: 黔首改化，遠邇同度，臨古絕尤。

translations.chinese: 黔首改化，遠邇同度，臨古絕尤。
translations.literal: The qianshou are transformed and changed; distant and near have the same measure; facing the ancient, he cuts off the exceptional.
translations.idiomatic: The commoners are transformed and changed; distant and near have the same measure; facing the ancient, he cuts off the exceptional.

context.previous: 職臣遵分，各知所行，事無嫌疑。
context.next: 常職既定，後嗣循業，長承聖治。

translations.chinese: 常職既定，後嗣循業，長承聖治。
translations.literal: Constant offices are already determined; later descendants follow the enterprise; long receive holy governance.
translations.idiomatic: Constant offices are already determined; later descendants follow the enterprise; long receive holy governance.

context.previous: 黔首改化，遠邇同度，臨古絕尤。
context.next: 群臣嘉德，祗誦聖烈，請刻之罘。

translations.chinese: 群臣嘉德，祗誦聖烈，請刻之罘。
translations.literal: The ministers praise the virtue, respectfully recite the holy achievements, request it carved on Zhifu.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers praise the virtue, respectfully recite the holy achievements, request it carved on Zhifu.

context.previous: 常職既定，後嗣循業，長承聖治。

translations.chinese: 旋，遂之瑯邪，道上黨入。
translations.literal: He turned back, then went to Langye, entering by way of Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: He turned back, then went to Langye, entering by way of Shangdang.

translations.chinese: 三十年，無事。
translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, there were no affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, there were no affairs.

translations.chinese: 三十一年十二月，更名臘曰「嘉平」。
translations.literal: Thirty-first year twelfth month, changed named la said 'Jia Ping'.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, twelfth month, he changed the name of la to 'Jiapin.'

context.next: 賜黔首裏六石米，二羊。

translations.chinese: 賜黔首裏六石米，二羊。
translations.literal: He granted the qianshou six shi of rice per li and two sheep.
translations.idiomatic: He granted the commoners six shi of rice per li and two sheep.

context.previous: 三十一年十二月，更名臘曰「嘉平」。
context.next: 始皇為微行咸陽，與武士四人俱，夜出逢盜蘭池，見窘，武士擊殺盜，關中大索二十日。

translations.chinese: 始皇為微行咸陽，與武士四人俱，夜出逢盜蘭池，見窘，武士擊殺盜，關中大索二十日。
translations.literal: The First Emperor made a secret journey in Xianyang, together with four martial warriors. Going out at night, they encountered bandits at Lan Pool. Seeing him distressed, the martial warriors struck and killed the bandits. There was a great search in Guanzhong for twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor made a secret journey in Xianyang, together with four martial warriors. Going out at night, they encountered bandits at Lan Pool. Seeing him distressed, the martial warriors struck and killed the bandits. There was a great search in Guanzhong for twenty days.

context.previous: 賜黔首裏六石米，二羊。
context.next: 米石千六百。

translations.chinese: 米石千六百。
translations.literal: Rice was one thousand six hundred per shi.
translations.idiomatic: Rice was one thousand six hundred per shi.

context.previous: 始皇為微行咸陽，與武士四人俱，夜出逢盜蘭池，見窘，武士擊殺盜，關中大索二十日。

translations.chinese: 三十二年，始皇之碣石，使燕人盧生求羨門、高誓。
translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, the First Emperor went to Jieshi and made the Yan man Lu Sheng seek Xianmen and Gaoshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, the First Emperor went to Jieshi and had the Yan man Lu Sheng seek Xianmen and Gaoshi.

context.next: 刻碣石門。

translations.chinese: 刻碣石門。
translations.literal: He carved on Jieshi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He carved on Jieshi Gate.

context.previous: 三十二年，始皇之碣石，使燕人盧生求羨門、高誓。
context.next: 壞城郭，決通隄防。

translations.chinese: 壞城郭，決通隄防。
translations.literal: He destroyed city walls and breached dike defenses to connect them.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed city walls and breached dike defenses to connect them.

context.previous: 刻碣石門。
context.next: 其辭曰：

translations.chinese: 其辭曰：
translations.literal: Its words said:
translations.idiomatic: Its words said:

context.previous: 壞城郭，決通隄防。

translations.chinese: 遂興師旅，誅戮無道，為逆滅息。
translations.literal: He then aroused troops and armies, executed and slaughtered the unprincipled, extinguished rebelliousness and caused it to cease.
translations.idiomatic: He then aroused troops and armies, executed and slaughtered the unprincipled, extinguished rebelliousness and caused it to cease.

context.next: 武殄暴逆，文復無罪，庶心咸服。

translations.chinese: 武殄暴逆，文復無罪，庶心咸服。
translations.literal: Martially he extinguished the violent and rebellious; civilly he restored the innocent; the populace's hearts all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Martially he extinguished the violent and rebellious; civilly he restored the innocent; the populace's hearts all submitted.

context.previous: 遂興師旅，誅戮無道，為逆滅息。
context.next: 惠論功勞，賞及牛馬，恩肥土域。

translations.chinese: 惠論功勞，賞及牛馬，恩肥土域。
translations.literal: Benevolently he evaluated merit and labor; rewards reached oxen and horses; favor enriched the soil domain.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolently he evaluated merit and labor; rewards reached oxen and horses; favor enriched the soil domain.

context.previous: 武殄暴逆，文復無罪，庶心咸服。
context.next: 皇帝奮威，德并諸侯，初一泰平。

translations.chinese: 皇帝奮威，德并諸侯，初一泰平。
translations.literal: The Emperor exerted his might; his virtue united the feudal lords; initially unified great peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor exerted his might; his virtue united the feudal lords; initially unified great peace.

context.previous: 惠論功勞，賞及牛馬，恩肥土域。
context.next: 墮壞城郭，決通川防，夷去險阻。

translations.chinese: 墮壞城郭，決通川防，夷去險阻。
translations.literal: He destroyed city walls, breached and connected river defenses, leveled and removed dangers and obstacles.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed city walls, breached and connected river defenses, leveled and removed dangers and obstacles.

context.previous: 皇帝奮威，德并諸侯，初一泰平。

translations.idiomatic: The Yan man Lu Sheng was made to enter the sea and return, bringing matters of ghosts and spirits. He then presented recorded writings, saying 'The one who will destroy Qin is Hu.'

translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor then had General Meng Tian dispatch three hundred thousand troops to strike north at the Hu, roughly taking the Henan lands.

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, he sent various people who had once fled and absconded, debt sons-in-law, and merchants to roughly take the Luliang lands, making Guilin, Xiang commandery, and Nanhai, to suitably send them as garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, he dispatched various people who had once fled, debt sons-in-law, and merchants to roughly take the Luliang lands, establishing Guilin, Xiang commandery, and Nanhai, suitably sending them as garrisons.

translations.literal: He drove out the Xiongnu to the northwest.

translations.idiomatic: Again he had Meng Tian cross the river to take Banque, Yangshan, and Beijiazhong, building pavilion barriers to drive out the Rong people.

translations.idiomatic: A bright star appeared in the west.

translations.literal: The First Emperor set up wine in the Xianyang palace; seventy scholars came before him to wish longevity.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor held a banquet in the Xianyang palace; seventy scholars came before him to wish longevity.

context.next: 仆射周青臣進頌曰：「他時秦地不過千里，賴陛下神靈明聖，平定海內，放逐蠻夷，日月所照，莫不賓服。

translations.chinese: 仆射周青臣進頌曰：「他時秦地不過千里，賴陛下神靈明聖，平定海內，放逐蠻夷，日月所照，莫不賓服。
translations.literal: Pu She Zhou Qing Chen advanced praise said: 'Other times Qin land not exceed thousand li, relied Your Majesty divine spirit clear holy, pacified settled within seas, drove out barbarian Yi, sun moon what shone, none not submitted obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: The Pushed Zhou Qingchen advanced and praised, saying, 'In other times, Qin's lands did not exceed a thousand li. Relying on Your Majesty's divine spirit and clear holiness, you pacified and settled within the seas, drove out the barbarian Yi. Wherever sun and moon shone, none failed to submit and obey.'

context.previous: 始皇置酒咸陽宮，博士七十人前為壽。

translations.chinese: 以諸侯為郡縣，人人自安樂，無戰爭之患，傳之萬世。
translations.literal: He made the feudal lords into commanderies and counties; people each are peacefully happy themselves, without the troubles of warfare, transmitting it to ten thousand generations.'
translations.idiomatic: He made the feudal lords into commanderies and counties; people each are peacefully happy themselves, without the troubles of warfare, transmitting it to ten thousand generations.'

context.next: 自上古不及陛下威德。」

translations.chinese: 自上古不及陛下威德。」
translations.literal: From high ancient not reach Your Majesty might virtue.'
translations.idiomatic: From high antiquity they do not reach Your Majesty's might and virtue.'

translations.literal: The First Emperor was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor was pleased.

translations.chinese: 博士齊人淳于越進曰：「臣聞殷周之王千餘歲，封子弟功臣，自為枝輔。
translations.literal: Scholar Qi person Chun Yu Yue advanced said: 'Minister heard Yin Zhou of kings thousand more years, enfeoffed sons younger brothers meritorious ministers, self made branch supports.
translations.idiomatic: The scholar, the Qi man Chunyu Yue, advanced and said, 'I have heard that the kings of Yin and Zhou lasted over a thousand years. They enfeoffed sons, younger brothers, and meritorious ministers, making them branch supports for themselves.'

context.previous: 始皇悅。
context.next: 今陛下有海內，而子弟為匹夫，卒有田常、六卿之臣，無輔拂，何以相救哉？

translations.chinese: 今陛下有海內，而子弟為匹夫，卒有田常、六卿之臣，無輔拂，何以相救哉？
translations.literal: Now Your Majesty has within seas, yet sons younger brothers as common men, suddenly have Tian Chang, six ministers of ministers, no support brush, what with mutually save?
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty possesses within the seas, yet your sons and younger brothers are common men. Suddenly there may be ministers like Tian Chang or the Six Ministers, with no support or brush—how will you mutually save each other?'

context.previous: 博士齊人淳于越進曰：「臣聞殷周之王千餘歲，封子弟功臣，自為枝輔。
context.next: 事不師古而能長久者，非所聞也。

translations.chinese: 事不師古而能長久者，非所聞也。
translations.literal: Affairs that do not take the ancient as teacher yet are able to last long—that is not what I have heard.'
translations.idiomatic: Affairs that do not take the ancient as teacher yet are able to last long—that is not what I have heard.'

context.next: 今青臣又面諛以重陛下之過，非忠臣。」

translations.chinese: 今青臣又面諛以重陛下之過，非忠臣。」
translations.literal: Now Qing Chen also face flattered to increase Your Majesty of errors, not loyal minister.'
translations.idiomatic: Now Qingchen also flatters to your face to increase Your Majesty's errors—he is not a loyal minister.'

context.previous: 事不師古而能長久者，非所聞也。
context.next: 始皇下其議。

translations.chinese: 始皇下其議。
translations.literal: The First Emperor sent down their discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor sent down their discussion.

context.previous: 今青臣又面諛以重陛下之過，非忠臣。」

translations.literal: Chancellor Li Si said: 'Five emperors not mutually repeat, three dynasties not mutually follow, each with governance, not their oppose reverse, time changed different also.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Li Si said, 'The Five Emperors did not mutually repeat each other, the Three Dynasties did not mutually follow each other. Each governed with their own ways; it is not that they opposed and reversed each other—times changed and were different.'

context.previous: 始皇下其議。

translations.chinese: 今陛下創大業，建萬世之功，固非愚儒所知。
translations.literal: Now Your Majesty has created a great enterprise and established merit for ten thousand generations. This is certainly not known by foolish scholars.'
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty has created a great enterprise and established merit for ten thousand generations. This is certainly not known by foolish scholars.'
