translations.literal: Moreover Yue words are three dynasties matters, what sufficient model also?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Yue's words are matters of the Three Dynasties—what is sufficient to model after?'

translations.literal: In different times, the feudal lords contended together and thickly recruited wandering scholars.'
translations.idiomatic: In different times, the feudal lords contended together and thickly recruited wandering scholars.'

context.previous: 且越言乃三代之事，何足法也？
context.next: 今天下已定，法令出一，百姓當家則力農工，士則學習法令辟禁。

translations.literal: Now the world is already determined, laws and commands come out as one. When common people are at home, they exert themselves in agriculture and labor; scholars study and learn the laws and commands, avoiding prohibitions.'
translations.idiomatic: Now the world is already determined, laws and commands come out as one. When common people are at home, they exert themselves in agriculture and labor; scholars study and learn the laws and commands, avoiding prohibitions.'

translations.literal: Now the various scholars do not take the present as teacher but study the ancient, in order to oppose the current age and confuse and disorder the qianshou.'
translations.idiomatic: Now the various scholars do not take the present as teacher but study the ancient, in order to oppose the current age and confuse and disorder the commoners.'

context.previous: 今天下已定，法令出一，百姓當家則力農工，士則學習法令辟禁。
context.next: 丞相臣斯昧死言：古者天下散亂，莫之能一，是以諸侯并作，語皆道古以害今，飾虛言以亂實，人善其所私學，以非上之所建立。

translations.chinese: 丞相臣斯昧死言：古者天下散亂，莫之能一，是以諸侯并作，語皆道古以害今，飾虛言以亂實，人善其所私學，以非上之所建立。
translations.literal: Chancellor minister Si risking death speaks: Ancient ones world scattered chaotic, none able unify it, therefore feudal lords together arose, words all spoke ancient to harm present, adorned empty words to disorder reality, people favored their private studies, to oppose superiors established.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Minister Si, risking death, speaks: In ancient times the world was scattered and chaotic, none could unify it. Therefore the feudal lords arose together; their words all spoke of the ancient to harm the present, adorned empty words to disorder reality. People favored their private studies to oppose what their superiors had established.'

context.previous: 今諸生不師今而學古，以非當世，惑亂黔首。

translations.chinese: 今皇帝并有天下，別黑白而定一尊。
translations.literal: Now the Emperor has united and possesses the world, distinguishes black and white and determines one honored.'
translations.idiomatic: Now the Emperor has united and possesses the world, distinguishes black and white and determines one honored.'

context.previous: 丞相臣斯昧死言：古者天下散亂，莫之能一，是以諸侯并作，語皆道古以害今，飾虛言以亂實，人善其所私學，以非上之所建立。
context.next: 私學而相與非法教，人聞令下，則各以其學議之，入則心非，出則巷議，夸主以為名，異取以為高，率群下以造謗。

translations.chinese: 私學而相與非法教，人聞令下，則各以其學議之，入則心非，出則巷議，夸主以為名，異取以為高，率群下以造謗。
translations.literal: Private studies mutually engage in illegal teachings. When people hear commands descend, each discusses them with their studies. When they enter, their hearts oppose; when they exit, they discuss in alleys. They boast of their masters for names, take different things as high, and lead the group below to make slander.'
translations.idiomatic: Private studies mutually engage in illegal teachings. When people hear commands descend, each discusses them with their studies. When they enter, their hearts oppose; when they exit, they discuss in alleys. They boast of their masters for names, take different things as high, and lead the group below to make slander.'

context.previous: 今皇帝并有天下，別黑白而定一尊。

translations.literal: If like this it is not prohibited, then the ruler's power will descend to the superiors, and factions and alliances will form below.'
translations.idiomatic: If like this it is not prohibited, then the ruler's power will descend to the superiors, and factions and alliances will form below.'

context.next: 禁之便。

translations.literal: Prohibiting it is convenient.'
translations.idiomatic: Prohibiting it is convenient.'

context.previous: 如此弗禁，則主勢降乎上，黨與成乎下。
context.next: 臣請史官非秦記皆燒之。

translations.chinese: 臣請史官非秦記皆燒之。
translations.literal: I request that the court historians burn all records that are not of Qin.'
translations.idiomatic: I request that the court historians burn all records that are not of Qin.'

context.previous: 禁之便。
context.next: 非博士官所職，天下敢有藏詩、書、百家語者，悉詣守、尉雜燒之。

translations.idiomatic: Those not in the charge of the scholar officials—throughout the world, those who dare to hide poems, books, and the words of the Hundred Schools, all go to the commandery governors and commandery lieutenants to mix and burn them.'

context.previous: 臣請史官非秦記皆燒之。

translations.chinese: 有敢偶語詩書者棄市。
translations.literal: Those who dare to discuss poems and books in pairs shall be abandoned in the market.'
translations.idiomatic: Those who dare to discuss poems and books in pairs shall be abandoned in the market.'

context.previous: 非博士官所職，天下敢有藏詩、書、百家語者，悉詣守、尉雜燒之。
context.next: 以古非今者族。

translations.chinese: 以古非今者族。
translations.literal: Those who use the ancient to oppose the present shall be clanned.'
translations.idiomatic: Those who use the ancient to oppose the present shall be clanned.'

context.previous: 有敢偶語詩書者棄市。

translations.literal: Officials who see and know but do not report shall be with the same crime.'
translations.idiomatic: Officials who see and know but do not report shall be with the same crime.'

translations.literal: If within thirty days of the command descending they do not burn, tattoo them as city morning.'
translations.idiomatic: If within thirty days of the command descending they do not burn, tattoo them as city morning.'

translations.idiomatic: Those not to be removed are books of medicine, divination, and planting trees.'

context.previous: 令下三十日不燒，黥為城旦。
context.next: 若欲有學法令，以吏為師。」

translations.chinese: 若欲有學法令，以吏為師。」
translations.literal: If desire have study laws commands, take officials as teachers.'
translations.idiomatic: If they desire to study laws and commands, take officials as teachers.'

context.previous: 所不去者，醫藥卜筮種樹之書。
context.next: 制曰：「可。」

translations.chinese: 制曰：「可。」
translations.literal: Decree said: 'Approved.'
translations.idiomatic: The decree said, 'Approved.'

context.previous: 若欲有學法令，以吏為師。」

translations.chinese: 三十五年，除道，道九原抵雲陽，塹山堙谷，直通之。
translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, roads were cleared. The road from Jiuyuan reached Yunyang; mountains were moated and valleys filled to directly connect them.

translations.chinese: 從臣誦烈，請刻此石，光垂休銘。
translations.literal: The attendant ministers recited the achievements, requested this stone be carved, bright and hung with beautiful inscription.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant ministers recited the achievements, requested this stone be carved, bright and hung with beautiful inscription.

context.previous: 後敬奉法，常治無極，輿舟不傾。

translations.chinese: 還過吳，從江乘渡。
translations.literal: He returned and passed Wu, crossed from Jiangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: He returned and passed Wu, crossed from Jiangcheng.

context.next: 并海上，北至瑯邪。

translations.chinese: 并海上，北至瑯邪。
translations.literal: Along the seaside, north to Langye.
translations.idiomatic: Along the seaside, north to Langye.

context.previous: 還過吳，從江乘渡。
context.next: 方士徐市等入海求神藥，數歲不得，費多，恐譴，乃詐曰：「蓬萊藥可得，然常為大鮫魚所苦，故不得至，願請善射與俱，見則以連弩射之。」

translations.chinese: 方士徐市等入海求神藥，數歲不得，費多，恐譴，乃詐曰：「蓬萊藥可得，然常為大鮫魚所苦，故不得至，願請善射與俱，見則以連弩射之。」
translations.literal: Prescription scholars Xu Shi etc. entered sea sought divine medicines, several years not obtained, expenses many, feared reprimand, then deceived said: 'Peng Lai medicines can be obtained, however often harmed by great jiao fish, therefore cannot reach, wish request good shooters with together, see then with linked crossbows shoot them.'
translations.idiomatic: The prescription scholars Xu Shi and others entered the sea to seek divine medicines. Several years they did not obtain them; expenses were many. Fearing reprimand, they then deceived and said, 'Penglai medicines can be obtained, however they are often harmed by great jiao fish, therefore cannot reach. We wish to request good shooters to come with us; when seen, shoot them with linked crossbows.'

context.previous: 并海上，北至瑯邪。
context.next: 始皇夢與海神戰，如人狀。

translations.chinese: 始皇夢與海神戰，如人狀。
translations.literal: The First Emperor dreamed he battled with the sea god, in human form.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor dreamed he battled with the sea god, in human form.

context.previous: 方士徐市等入海求神藥，數歲不得，費多，恐譴，乃詐曰：「蓬萊藥可得，然常為大鮫魚所苦，故不得至，願請善射與俱，見則以連弩射之。」
context.next: 問占夢，博士曰：「水神不可見，以大魚蛟龍為候。

translations.chinese: 問占夢，博士曰：「水神不可見，以大魚蛟龍為候。
translations.literal: Asked interpreted dream, scholars said: 'Water gods cannot be seen, with great fish jiao dragons as signs.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to interpret the dream. The scholars said, 'Water gods cannot be seen; they use great fish, jiao, and dragons as signs.'

context.previous: 始皇夢與海神戰，如人狀。
context.next: 今上禱祠備謹，而有此惡神，當除去，而善神可致。」

translations.chinese: 今上禱祠備謹，而有此惡神，當除去，而善神可致。」
translations.literal: Now His Majesty prayed sacrificed prepared respectful, yet has this evil spirit, should remove go, and good spirits can be brought.'
translations.idiomatic: Now His Majesty has prayed and sacrificed with prepared respectfulness, yet there is this evil spirit. It should be removed, and good spirits can be brought.'

context.previous: 問占夢，博士曰：「水神不可見，以大魚蛟龍為候。
context.next: 乃令入海者齎捕巨魚具，而自以連弩候大魚出射之。

translations.chinese: 乃令入海者齎捕巨魚具，而自以連弩候大魚出射之。
translations.literal: He then ordered those who entered the sea to carry tools for capturing giant fish, and himself with linked crossbow waited for great fish to appear and shot them.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered those who entered the sea to carry tools for capturing giant fish, and himself with a linked crossbow waited for great fish to appear and shot them.

context.previous: 今上禱祠備謹，而有此惡神，當除去，而善神可致。」
context.next: 自瑯邪北至榮成山，弗見。

translations.chinese: 自瑯邪北至榮成山，弗見。
translations.literal: From Langye north to Rongcheng Mountain, nothing was seen.
translations.idiomatic: From Langye north to Rongcheng Mountain, nothing was seen.

context.previous: 乃令入海者齎捕巨魚具，而自以連弩候大魚出射之。
context.next: 至之罘，見巨魚，射殺一魚。

translations.chinese: 至之罘，見巨魚，射殺一魚。
translations.literal: He reached Zhifu, saw giant fish, and shot and killed one fish.
translations.idiomatic: He reached Zhifu, saw giant fish, and shot and killed one fish.

context.previous: 自瑯邪北至榮成山，弗見。
context.next: 遂并海西。

translations.chinese: 遂并海西。
translations.literal: He then went along the sea to the west.
translations.idiomatic: He then went along the sea to the west.

context.previous: 至之罘，見巨魚，射殺一魚。

translations.chinese: 至平原津而病。
translations.literal: He reached Pingyuan Ford and became ill.
translations.idiomatic: He reached Pingyuan Ford and became ill.

context.next: 始皇惡言死，群臣莫敢言死事。

translations.chinese: 始皇惡言死，群臣莫敢言死事。
translations.literal: The First Emperor hated speaking of death; the ministers none dared speak of death matters.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor hated speaking of death; none of the ministers dared speak of death matters.

context.previous: 至平原津而病。
context.next: 上病益甚，乃為璽書賜公子扶蘇曰：「與喪會咸陽而葬。」

translations.chinese: 上病益甚，乃為璽書賜公子扶蘇曰：「與喪會咸陽而葬。」
translations.literal: His Majesty illness increasingly severe, then made seal letter granted prince Fu Su said: 'With mourning convene Xianyang and bury.'
translations.idiomatic: His Majesty's illness became increasingly severe. He then made a sealed letter granting to Prince Fusu, saying, 'Meet with the mourning at Xianyang and bury.'

context.previous: 始皇惡言死，群臣莫敢言死事。
context.next: 書已封，在中車府令趙高行符璽事所，未授使者。

translations.chinese: 書已封，在中車府令趙高行符璽事所，未授使者。
translations.literal: The letter was already sealed, at the place where the Middle Carriage Bureau Chief Zhao Gao administered tally and seal matters, not yet given to the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The letter was already sealed, at the place where the Middle Carriage Bureau Chief Zhao Gao administered tally and seal matters, not yet given to the envoy.

context.previous: 上病益甚，乃為璽書賜公子扶蘇曰：「與喪會咸陽而葬。」
context.next: 七月丙寅，始皇崩於沙丘平臺。

translations.chinese: 七月丙寅，始皇崩於沙丘平臺。
translations.literal: In the seventh month, Bingyin day, the First Emperor collapsed at the Shaqiu terrace platform.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Bingyin day, the First Emperor died at the Shaqiu terrace platform.

context.previous: 書已封，在中車府令趙高行符璽事所，未授使者。
context.next: 丞相斯為上崩在外，恐諸公子及天下有變，乃祕之，不發喪。

translations.chinese: 丞相斯為上崩在外，恐諸公子及天下有變，乃祕之，不發喪。
translations.literal: Chancellor Si, because His Majesty collapsed outside, feared that the various princes and the world might have changes, then secreted it and did not issue mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Si, because His Majesty died outside, feared that the various princes and the world might have changes, then kept it secret and did not announce the mourning.

context.previous: 七月丙寅，始皇崩於沙丘平臺。
context.next: 棺載轀涼車中，故幸宦者參乘，所至上食。

translations.chinese: 棺載轀涼車中，故幸宦者參乘，所至上食。
translations.literal: The coffin was loaded in the hearse cool carriage; former favored eunuchs accompanied the ride. Wherever they reached, food was offered.
translations.idiomatic: The coffin was loaded in the hearse cool carriage; former favored eunuchs accompanied the ride. Wherever they reached, food was offered.

context.previous: 丞相斯為上崩在外，恐諸公子及天下有變，乃祕之，不發喪。
context.next: 百官奏事如故，宦者輒從轀涼車中可其奏事。

translations.chinese: 百官奏事如故，宦者輒從轀涼車中可其奏事。
translations.literal: The hundred officials memorialized affairs as before; the eunuchs then from the hearse cool carriage approved their memorialized affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials memorialized affairs as before; the eunuchs then from the hearse cool carriage approved their memorialized affairs.

context.previous: 棺載轀涼車中，故幸宦者參乘，所至上食。
context.next: 獨子胡亥、趙高及所幸宦者五六人知上死。

translations.chinese: 獨子胡亥、趙高及所幸宦者五六人知上死。
translations.literal: Only the son Huhai, Zhao Gao, and five or six favored eunuchs knew of His Majesty's death.
translations.idiomatic: Only the son Huhai, Zhao Gao, and five or six favored eunuchs knew of His Majesty's death.

context.previous: 百官奏事如故，宦者輒從轀涼車中可其奏事。
context.next: 趙高故嘗教胡亥書及獄律令法事，胡亥私幸之。

translations.chinese: 趙高故嘗教胡亥書及獄律令法事，胡亥私幸之。
translations.literal: Zhao Gao had previously often taught Huhai writings and prison laws, commands, and affairs. Huhai privately favored him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gao had previously often taught Huhai writings and prison laws, commands, and affairs. Huhai privately favored him.

context.previous: 獨子胡亥、趙高及所幸宦者五六人知上死。
context.next: 高乃與公子胡亥、丞相斯陰謀破去始皇所封書賜公子扶蘇者，而更詐為丞相斯受始皇遺詔沙丘，立子胡亥為太子。

translations.chinese: 高乃與公子胡亥、丞相斯陰謀破去始皇所封書賜公子扶蘇者，而更詐為丞相斯受始皇遺詔沙丘，立子胡亥為太子。
translations.literal: Gao then secretly plotted with Prince Huhai and Chancellor Si to break away the First Emperor's sealed letter granting to Prince Fusu, and moreover deceived to make Chancellor Si receive the First Emperor's testament at Shaqiu, establishing the son Huhai as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Gao then secretly plotted with Prince Huhai and Chancellor Si to break away the First Emperor's sealed letter granting to Prince Fusu, and moreover deceived to make Chancellor Si receive the First Emperor's testament at Shaqiu, establishing the son Huhai as crown prince.

context.previous: 趙高故嘗教胡亥書及獄律令法事，胡亥私幸之。
context.next: 更為書賜公子扶蘇、蒙恬，數以罪，（其）賜死。

translations.chinese: 更為書賜公子扶蘇、蒙恬，數以罪，（其）賜死。
translations.literal: He moreover made a letter granting to Prince Fusu and Meng Tian, enumerating their crimes, granting them death.
translations.idiomatic: He moreover made a letter granting to Prince Fusu and Meng Tian, enumerating their crimes, granting them death.

context.previous: 高乃與公子胡亥、丞相斯陰謀破去始皇所封書賜公子扶蘇者，而更詐為丞相斯受始皇遺詔沙丘，立子胡亥為太子。
context.next: 語具在李斯傳中。

translations.chinese: 語具在李斯傳中。
translations.literal: The words are fully in the Li Si biography.
translations.idiomatic: The words are fully in the Li Si biography.

context.previous: 更為書賜公子扶蘇、蒙恬，數以罪，（其）賜死。
context.next: 行，遂從井陘抵九原。

translations.chinese: 行，遂從井陘抵九原。
translations.literal: They traveled, then from Jingxing reached Jiuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: They traveled, then from Jingxing reached Jiuyuan.

context.previous: 語具在李斯傳中。
context.next: 會暑，上轀車臭，乃詔從官令車載一石鮑魚，以亂其臭。

translations.chinese: 會暑，上轀車臭，乃詔從官令車載一石鮑魚，以亂其臭。
translations.literal: They met summer; His Majesty's hearse carriage stank. He then edicted the attendant officials to command the carriages to load one shi of dried fish, to confuse its stench.
translations.idiomatic: They met summer; His Majesty's hearse carriage stank. He then edicted the attendant officials to command the carriages to load one shi of dried fish, to mask its stench.

context.previous: 行，遂從井陘抵九原。

translations.chinese: 行從直道至咸陽，發喪。
translations.literal: They traveled from the straight road to Xianyang and issued mourning.
translations.idiomatic: They traveled from the straight road to Xianyang and issued mourning.

context.next: 太子胡亥襲位，為二世皇帝。

translations.chinese: 太子胡亥襲位，為二世皇帝。
translations.literal: Crown Prince Huhai inherited the position and became the Second Generation Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Huhai ascended the throne and became the Second Generation Emperor.

context.previous: 行從直道至咸陽，發喪。
context.next: 九月，葬始皇酈山。

translations.chinese: 九月，葬始皇酈山。
translations.literal: In the ninth month, they buried the First Emperor at Lishan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, they buried the First Emperor at Lishan.

context.previous: 太子胡亥襲位，為二世皇帝。
context.next: 始皇初即位，穿治酈山，及并天下，天下徒送詣七十餘萬人，穿三泉，下銅而致槨，宮觀百官奇器珍怪徙臧滿之。

translations.chinese: 始皇初即位，穿治酈山，及并天下，天下徒送詣七十餘萬人，穿三泉，下銅而致槨，宮觀百官奇器珍怪徙臧滿之。
translations.literal: When the First Emperor initially ascended the throne, he excavated and treated Lishan. When he united the world, convicts sent from the world reached over seven hundred thousand people. They excavated three springs, lowered copper and brought the coffin. Palace buildings, hundred officials' strange vessels, precious monsters—they moved and stored, filling it.
translations.idiomatic: When the First Emperor initially ascended the throne, he excavated and treated Lishan. When he united the world, convicts sent from the world reached over seven hundred thousand people. They excavated three springs, lowered copper and brought the coffin. Palace buildings, hundred officials' strange vessels, precious monsters—they moved and stored, filling it.

context.previous: 九月，葬始皇酈山。
context.next: 令匠作機弩矢，有所穿近者輒射之。

translations.chinese: 令匠作機弩矢，有所穿近者輒射之。
translations.literal: He commanded artisans to make machine crossbows and arrows; those who approached the excavations were then shot.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded artisans to make machine crossbows and arrows; those who approached the excavations were then shot.

context.previous: 始皇初即位，穿治酈山，及并天下，天下徒送詣七十餘萬人，穿三泉，下銅而致槨，宮觀百官奇器珍怪徙臧滿之。
context.next: 以水銀為百川江河大海，機相灌輸，上具天文，下具地理。

translations.chinese: 以水銀為百川江河大海，機相灌輸，上具天文，下具地理。
translations.literal: He used mercury to represent the hundred streams, the Jiang, rivers, and great seas, with machines that poured into each other. Above were equipped the heavenly patterns; below were equipped the earthly forms.
translations.idiomatic: He used mercury to model the hundred streams, the Yangtze, the rivers, and the great seas, with mechanisms that fed into one another. Above were celestial patterns; below were earthly forms.

context.previous: 令匠作機弩矢，有所穿近者輒射之。
context.next: 以人魚膏為燭，度不滅者久之。

translations.chinese: 以人魚膏為燭，度不滅者久之。
translations.literal: He used mermaid fat for candles, and those that did not extinguish lasted a long time.
translations.idiomatic: He used candles made from mermaid fat, and they burned for an exceptionally long time.

context.previous: 以水銀為百川江河大海，機相灌輸，上具天文，下具地理。
context.next: 二世曰：「先帝後宮非有子者，出焉不宜。」

translations.chinese: 二世曰：「先帝後宮非有子者，出焉不宜。」
translations.literal: Second generation said: 'Former emperor rear palace not having sons ones, go out indeed not proper.'
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor said, 'The First Emperor's rear palace women who do not have sons—it is not proper to send them out.'

context.previous: 以人魚膏為燭，度不滅者久之。
context.next: 皆令從死，死者甚眾。

translations.chinese: 皆令從死，死者甚眾。
translations.literal: All were ordered to follow in death; those who died were very many.
translations.idiomatic: All were ordered to follow in death; those who died were very many.

context.previous: 二世曰：「先帝後宮非有子者，出焉不宜。」
context.next: 葬既已下，或言工匠為機，臧皆知之，臧重即泄。

translations.chinese: 葬既已下，或言工匠為機，臧皆知之，臧重即泄。
translations.literal: When the burial had already descended, some said the artisans had made machines, and all the stored valuables knew it—the valuables were heavy and would leak.
translations.idiomatic: When the tomb chamber had been lowered, some said the artisans had installed a mechanism inside, and the buried treasures were all in on it; once they grew heavy, they would seep out.

context.previous: 皆令從死，死者甚眾。
context.next: 大事畢，已臧，閉中羨，下外羨門，盡閉工匠臧者，無復出者。

translations.chinese: 大事畢，已臧，閉中羨，下外羨門，盡閉工匠臧者，無復出者。
translations.literal: The great matters were finished, already stored, the middle passages closed, the outer passage doors lowered, all the artisans and stored ones completely closed in, with none able to exit again.
translations.idiomatic: Once the great work was finished and everything stored away, the inner passages were sealed, the outer gates lowered, and all the artisans and keepers were shut in, never to come out again.

context.previous: 葬既已下，或言工匠為機，臧皆知之，臧重即泄。
context.next: 樹草木以象山。

translations.chinese: 樹草木以象山。
translations.literal: He planted grass and trees to resemble mountains.
translations.idiomatic: He planted grass and trees to resemble mountains.

context.previous: 大事畢，已臧，閉中羨，下外羨門，盡閉工匠臧者，無復出者。

translations.chinese: 二世皇帝元年，年二十一。
translations.literal: In the first year of the Second Emperor, he was twenty-one years old.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Second Emperor, he was twenty-one years old.

context.next: 趙高為郎中令，任用事。

translations.chinese: 趙高為郎中令，任用事。
translations.literal: Zhao Gao served as the Chamberlain for Attendants, responsible for handling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gao served as the Chamberlain for Attendants, responsible for handling affairs.

context.previous: 二世皇帝元年，年二十一。
context.next: 二世下詔，增始皇寢廟犧牲及山川百祀之禮。

translations.chinese: 二世下詔，增始皇寢廟犧牲及山川百祀之禮。
translations.literal: The Second Emperor issued an edict increasing the sacrifices at the First Emperor's sleeping temples and the hundred rites for mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor issued an edict increasing the sacrifices at the First Emperor's sleeping temples and the hundred rites for mountains and rivers.

context.previous: 趙高為郎中令，任用事。
context.next: 令群臣議尊始皇廟。

translations.chinese: 令群臣議尊始皇廟。
translations.literal: He commanded the ministers to discuss honoring the First Emperor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded the ministers to discuss honoring the First Emperor's temple.

context.previous: 二世下詔，增始皇寢廟犧牲及山川百祀之禮。
context.next: 群臣皆頓首言曰：「古者天子七廟，諸侯五，大夫三，雖萬世世不軼毀。

translations.chinese: 群臣皆頓首言曰：「古者天子七廟，諸侯五，大夫三，雖萬世世不軼毀。
translations.literal: Ministers all kowtowed spoke said: 'Ancient ones emperor seven temples, feudal lords five, grand masters three, though ten thousand generations not exceed destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: All the ministers kowtowed and said, 'In ancient times, emperors had seven temples, feudal lords five, grand masters three, though ten thousand generations did not exceed destruction.

context.previous: 令群臣議尊始皇廟。
context.next: 今始皇為極廟，四海之內皆獻貢職，增犧牲，禮咸備，毋以加。

translations.chinese: 今始皇為極廟，四海之內皆獻貢職，增犧牲，禮咸備，毋以加。
translations.literal: Now the First Emperor is the extreme temple; within the four seas all offer tribute and duties, increased sacrifices, rites all prepared—nothing can be added.
translations.idiomatic: Now the First Emperor is the extreme temple; within the four seas all offer tribute and duties, increased sacrifices, rites all prepared—nothing can be added.

context.previous: 群臣皆頓首言曰：「古者天子七廟，諸侯五，大夫三，雖萬世世不軼毀。
context.next: 先王廟或在西雍，或在咸陽。

translations.chinese: 先王廟或在西雍，或在咸陽。
translations.literal: Former kings' temples are either in West Yong or in Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Former kings' temples are either in West Yong or in Xianyang.

context.previous: 今始皇為極廟，四海之內皆獻貢職，增犧牲，禮咸備，毋以加。
context.next: 天子儀當獨奉酌祠始皇廟。

translations.chinese: 天子儀當獨奉酌祠始皇廟。
translations.literal: The emperor's ceremonies should alone serve libations and sacrifice at the First Emperor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's ceremonies should alone serve libations and sacrifice at the First Emperor's temple.

context.previous: 先王廟或在西雍，或在咸陽。
context.next: 自襄公已下軼毀。

translations.chinese: 自襄公已下軼毀。
translations.literal: From Duke Xiang downward they have exceeded destruction.
translations.idiomatic: From Duke Xiang downward they have exceeded destruction.

context.previous: 天子儀當獨奉酌祠始皇廟。
context.next: 所置凡七廟。

translations.chinese: 所置凡七廟。
translations.literal: What has been established totals seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: What has been established totals seven temples.

translations.idiomatic: A later envoy arrived; His Majesty asked, and he replied, 'Bandits—the commandery defenders and commandants are just pursuing and capturing them; now they are completely obtained. Not sufficient to worry.'

translations.literal: His Majesty was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: His Majesty was pleased.

translations.idiomatic: Xiang Liang raised troops in the Kuaiji commandery.

translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the second year, the generals Zhou Zhang and others whom Chen She had dispatched went west to Xi, with troops numbering several tens of thousands.

translations.chinese: 二世大驚，與群臣謀曰：「柰何？」
translations.literal: Second generation greatly startled, with ministers plotted said: 'What to do?'
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor was greatly startled and plotted with the ministers, saying, 'What should we do?'

context.previous: 二年冬，陳涉所遣周章等將西至戲，兵數十萬。

translations.chinese: 少府章邯曰：「盜已至，眾彊，今發近縣不及矣。
translations.literal: Minor treasury Zhang Han said: 'Robbers already arrived, multitude strong, now dispatch near counties not in time already.
translations.idiomatic: The Minor Treasurer Zhang Han said, 'The robbers have already arrived; their multitude is strong. Now dispatching the near counties will not be in time.

context.previous: 二世大驚，與群臣謀曰：「柰何？」
context.next: 酈山徒多，請赦之，授兵以擊之。」

translations.chinese: 酈山徒多，請赦之，授兵以擊之。」
translations.literal: Li mountain convicts many, please pardon them, give weapons to strike them.'
translations.idiomatic: The Mount Li convicts are many; please pardon them and give them weapons to strike the robbers.'

context.previous: 少府章邯曰：「盜已至，眾彊，今發近縣不及矣。
context.next: 二世乃大赦天下，使章邯將，擊破周章軍而走，遂殺章曹陽。

translations.chinese: 二世乃大赦天下，使章邯將，擊破周章軍而走，遂殺章曹陽。
translations.literal: The Second Emperor then greatly pardoned the world, made Zhang Han the general, struck and broke Zhou Zhang's army causing it to flee, and then killed Zhang at Cao Yang.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor then greatly pardoned the world, made Zhang Han the general, struck and broke Zhou Zhang's army causing it to flee, and then killed Zhang at Cao Yang.

translations.chinese: 二世益遣長史司馬欣、董翳佐章邯擊盜，殺陳勝城父，破項梁定陶，滅魏咎臨濟。
translations.literal: The Second Emperor moreover dispatched the Chief Clerk Sima Xin and Dong Yi to assist Zhang Han in striking the robbers. They killed Chen Sheng at Chengfu, broke Xiang Liang at Dingtao, and extinguished Wei Jiu at Linji.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor moreover dispatched the Chief Clerk Sima Xin and Dong Yi to assist Zhang Han in striking the robbers. They killed Chen Sheng at Chengfu, broke Xiang Liang at Dingtao, and extinguished Wei Jiu at Linji.

context.previous: 二世乃大赦天下，使章邯將，擊破周章軍而走，遂殺章曹陽。
context.next: 楚地盜名將已死，章邯乃北渡河，擊趙王歇等於鉅鹿。

translations.literal: The Chu lands' robbers' famous generals had already died; Zhang Han then crossed the river north and struck King Xie of Zhao and others at Julu.
translations.idiomatic: The Chu lands' robbers' famous generals had already died; Zhang Han then crossed the river north and struck King Xie of Zhao and others at Julu.

translations.chinese: 趙高說二世曰：「先帝臨制天下久，故群臣不敢為非，進邪說。
translations.literal: Zhao Gao persuaded second generation said: 'Former emperor controlled ruled world long, therefore ministers not dared do wrong, advance evil sayings.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gao persuaded the Second Emperor, saying, 'The First Emperor controlled and ruled the world for a long time; therefore the ministers did not dare do wrong or advance evil sayings.

context.next: 今陛下富於春秋，初即位，柰何與公卿廷決事？

translations.chinese: 今陛下富於春秋，初即位，柰何與公卿廷決事？
translations.literal: Now Your Majesty rich in spring autumns, initially ascended position, what with nobles court decide affairs?
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty is rich in years, having just ascended the position—what need is there to decide affairs with the nobles in court?

context.previous: 趙高說二世曰：「先帝臨制天下久，故群臣不敢為非，進邪說。
context.next: 事即有誤，示群臣短也。

translations.chinese: 事即有誤，示群臣短也。
translations.literal: If affairs then have errors, it shows the ministers your shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: If affairs then have errors, it shows the ministers your shortcomings.

context.previous: 今陛下富於春秋，初即位，柰何與公卿廷決事？
context.next: 天子稱朕，固不聞聲。」

translations.chinese: 天子稱朕，固不聞聲。」
translations.literal: Emperor calls I, certainly not hears voice.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor calls himself 'I'; certainly he does not hear the voice.'

context.previous: 事即有誤，示群臣短也。
context.next: 於是二世常居禁中，與高決諸事。

translations.chinese: 於是二世常居禁中，與高決諸事。
translations.literal: Thereupon the Second Emperor constantly resided in the forbidden quarters and decided all affairs with Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Second Emperor constantly resided in the forbidden quarters and decided all affairs with Gao.

context.previous: 天子稱朕，固不聞聲。」
context.next: 其後公卿希得朝見，盜賊益多，而關中卒發東擊盜者毋已。

translations.chinese: 其後公卿希得朝見，盜賊益多，而關中卒發東擊盜者毋已。
translations.literal: After this, the nobles rarely obtained morning audiences; robbers and bandits grew increasingly many, and the soldiers dispatched from Guanzhong to strike the robbers in the east were without end.
translations.idiomatic: After this, the nobles rarely obtained morning audiences; robbers and bandits grew increasingly many, and the soldiers dispatched from Guanzhong to strike the robbers in the east were without end.

context.previous: 於是二世常居禁中，與高決諸事。
context.next: 右丞相去疾、左丞相斯、將軍馮劫進諫曰：「關東群盜并起，秦發兵誅擊，所殺亡甚眾，然猶不止。

translations.chinese: 右丞相去疾、左丞相斯、將軍馮劫進諫曰：「關東群盜并起，秦發兵誅擊，所殺亡甚眾，然猶不止。
translations.literal: Right chancellor Qu Ji, left chancellor Si, general Feng Jie advanced remonstrated said: 'Guan east bandits together rose, Qin dispatched troops executed struck, what killed perished very many, however still not stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Chancellor Qu Ji, Left Chancellor Si, and General Feng Jie advanced and remonstrated, saying, 'The bandits east of the pass have all risen together. Qin has dispatched troops to execute and strike them; those killed and perished are very many, yet they still do not stop.

context.previous: 其後公卿希得朝見，盜賊益多，而關中卒發東擊盜者毋已。
context.next: 盜多，皆以戌漕轉作事苦，賦稅大也。

translations.chinese: 盜多，皆以戌漕轉作事苦，賦稅大也。
translations.literal: The robbers are many; all are because the garrison, transport, and labor matters are bitter, and the taxes are heavy.
translations.idiomatic: The robbers are many; all are because the garrison, transport, and labor matters are bitter, and the taxes are heavy.

context.previous: 右丞相去疾、左丞相斯、將軍馮劫進諫曰：「關東群盜并起，秦發兵誅擊，所殺亡甚眾，然猶不止。

translations.chinese: 請且止阿房宮作者，減省四邊戍轉。」
translations.literal: Please temporarily stop Efang palace workers, reduce save four borders garrisons transports.'
translations.idiomatic: Please temporarily stop the Epang Palace workers and reduce the garrisons and transports on the four borders.'

context.previous: 盜多，皆以戌漕轉作事苦，賦稅大也。

translations.literal: Second generation said: 'I heard Han Zi said: 'Yao Shun thatched rafters not scraped, thatched roofs not trimmed, ate earthenware bowls, drank earthenware cups, though gatekeeper nourishment, not different from this.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor said, 'I heard Master Han say: "Yao and Shun used thatched rafters not scraped, thatched roofs not trimmed, ate from earthenware bowls, drank from earthenware cups. Though the gatekeeper's nourishment was not different from this."

translations.chinese: 禹鑿龍門，通大夏，決河亭水，放之海，身自持筑臿，脛毋毛，臣虜之勞不烈於此矣。』
translations.literal: Yu dug Long Men, connected Da Xia, decided He Ting waters, released to sea, body self held hoe spade, shins no hair, minister captive labor not intense as this already.'
translations.idiomatic: Yu dug Longmen, connected Daxia, decided the Hetting waters and released them to the sea. His body personally held the hoe and spade; his shins had no hair. The labor of ministers and captives was not as intense as this."'

translations.literal: All that is done by those who nobly have the world is to obtain unrestrained intentions and extreme desires, to be a lord who heavily enforces clear laws, so that below they dare not do wrong, to thereby control and rule within the seas.
translations.idiomatic: All that is done by those who nobly have the world is to obtain unrestrained intentions and extreme desires, to be a lord who heavily enforces clear laws, so that below they dare not do wrong, to thereby control and rule within the seas.

context.previous: 禹鑿龍門，通大夏，決河亭水，放之海，身自持筑臿，脛毋毛，臣虜之勞不烈於此矣。』
context.next: 夫虞、夏之主，貴為天子，親處窮苦之實，以徇百姓，尚何於法？

translations.chinese: 夫虞、夏之主，貴為天子，親處窮苦之實，以徇百姓，尚何於法？
translations.literal: Husband Yu Xia of lords, noble as emperor, personally dwelt poor bitter of reality, to comply common people, still what at laws?
translations.idiomatic: The lords of Yu and Xia, noble as emperors, personally dwelt in the reality of poverty and bitterness to comply with the common people—what more is there regarding laws?

context.previous: 凡所為貴有天下者，得肆意極欲，主重明法，下不敢為非，以制御海內矣。
context.next: 朕尊萬乘，毋其實，吾欲造千乘之駕，萬乘之屬，充吾號名。

translations.chinese: 朕尊萬乘，毋其實，吾欲造千乘之駕，萬乘之屬，充吾號名。
translations.literal: I am honored with ten thousand chariots but lack its substance. I wish to make the equipage of a thousand chariots and the retinue of ten thousand chariots to fill my title and name.
translations.idiomatic: I am honored with ten thousand chariots but lack its substance. I wish to make the equipage of a thousand chariots and the retinue of ten thousand chariots to fill my title and name.

context.previous: 夫虞、夏之主，貴為天子，親處窮苦之實，以徇百姓，尚何於法？

translations.chinese: 且先帝起諸侯，兼天下，天下已定，外攘四夷以安邊竟，作宮室以章得意，而君觀先帝功業有緒。
translations.literal: Moreover, the First Emperor rose from the feudal lords and united the world. The world was already settled; externally he expelled the four barbarians to pacify the border limits, made palace chambers to manifest his self-satisfaction, and you observe that the First Emperor's achievements had continuity.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the First Emperor rose from the feudal lords and united the world. The world was already settled; externally he expelled the four barbarians to pacify the border limits, made palace chambers to manifest his self-satisfaction, and you observe that the First Emperor's achievements had continuity.

translations.chinese: 今朕即位二年之閒，群盜并起，君不能禁，又欲罷先帝之所為，是上毋以報先帝，次不為朕盡忠力，何以在位？」
translations.literal: Now I ascended position two years interval, bandits together rose, you cannot prohibit, moreover wish dismiss former emperor what did, is above not able repay former emperor, next not for I exhaust loyal strength, why in position?'
translations.idiomatic: Now I have ascended the position within two years' interval; bandits have all risen together. You cannot prohibit them, and moreover wish to dismiss what the First Emperor did. This is above not being able to repay the First Emperor, and next not exhausting loyal strength for me—why are you in position?'

context.previous: 且先帝起諸侯，兼天下，天下已定，外攘四夷以安邊竟，作宮室以章得意，而君觀先帝功業有緒。
context.next: 下去疾、斯、劫吏，案責他罪。

translations.chinese: 下去疾、斯、劫吏，案責他罪。
translations.literal: He sent down Qu Ji, Si, and Jie to the officials, investigated and blamed them for other crimes.
translations.idiomatic: He sent down Qu Ji, Si, and Jie to the officials, investigated and blamed them for other crimes.

context.previous: 今朕即位二年之閒，群盜并起，君不能禁，又欲罷先帝之所為，是上毋以報先帝，次不為朕盡忠力，何以在位？」
context.next: 去疾、劫曰：「將相不辱。」

translations.chinese: 去疾、劫曰：「將相不辱。」
translations.literal: Qu Ji, Jie said: 'Generals chancellors not humiliated.'
translations.idiomatic: Qu Ji and Jie said, 'Generals and chancellors are not humiliated.'

context.previous: 下去疾、斯、劫吏，案責他罪。
context.next: 自殺。

translations.chinese: 自殺。
translations.literal: They committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: They committed suicide.

context.previous: 去疾、劫曰：「將相不辱。」
context.next: 斯卒囚，就五刑。

translations.chinese: 斯卒囚，就五刑。
translations.literal: Si was finally imprisoned and received the five punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Si was finally imprisoned and received the five punishments.

context.previous: 自殺。

translations.chinese: 三年，章邯等將其卒圍鉅鹿，楚上將軍項羽將楚卒往救鉅鹿。
translations.literal: In the third year, Zhang Han and others led their soldiers to surround Julu. The Chu Supreme General Xiang Yu led Chu soldiers to go rescue Julu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Zhang Han and others led their soldiers to surround Julu. The Chu Supreme General Xiang Yu led Chu soldiers to go rescue Julu.

context.next: 冬，趙高為丞相，竟案李斯殺之。

translations.chinese: 冬，趙高為丞相，竟案李斯殺之。
translations.literal: In winter, Zhao Gao became chancellor and finally investigated and killed Li Si.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, Zhao Gao became chancellor and finally investigated and killed Li Si.

context.previous: 三年，章邯等將其卒圍鉅鹿，楚上將軍項羽將楚卒往救鉅鹿。

translations.literal: In summer, Zhang Han and others battled with several retreats. The Second Emperor sent someone to reproach Han; Han feared and had the chief clerk Xin request affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, Zhang Han and others battled with several retreats. The Second Emperor sent someone to reproach Han; Han feared and had the chief clerk Xin request affairs.

context.previous: 冬，趙高為丞相，竟案李斯殺之。
context.next: 趙高弗見，又弗信。

translations.chinese: 趙高弗見，又弗信。
translations.literal: Zhao Gao did not see him, and moreover did not believe him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gao did not see him, and moreover did not believe him.

context.previous: 夏，章邯等戰數卻，二世使人讓邯，邯恐，使長史欣請事。
context.next: 欣恐，亡去，高使人捕追不及。

translations.chinese: 欣恐，亡去，高使人捕追不及。
translations.literal: Xin feared and fled. Gao sent people to seize and pursue him but did not reach him.
translations.idiomatic: Xin feared and fled. Gao sent people to seize and pursue him but did not reach him.

context.previous: 趙高弗見，又弗信。
context.next: 欣見邯曰：「趙高用事於中，將軍有功亦誅，無功亦誅。」

translations.literal: Xin saw Han said: 'Zhao Gao uses affairs in middle, general has merit also executed, no merit also executed.'
translations.idiomatic: Xin saw Han and said, 'Zhao Gao controls affairs within; the general will be executed whether he has merit or not.'

translations.literal: Xiang Yu urgently struck the Qin army, captured Wang Li, and Han and others then surrendered their troops to the feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Yu urgently struck the Qin army, captured Wang Li, and Han and others then surrendered their troops to the feudal lords.

context.previous: 欣見邯曰：「趙高用事於中，將軍有功亦誅，無功亦誅。」

translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month Jihai day, Zhao Gao wished to make chaos. Fearing the ministers would not listen, he first set a test, held a deer and offered it to the Second Emperor, saying, 'This is a horse.'

context.previous: 項羽急擊秦軍，虜王離，邯等遂以兵降諸侯。

translations.literal: Second generation laughed said: 'Chancellor mistaken ah?
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor laughed and said, 'Is the Chancellor mistaken?

translations.chinese: 高前數言「關東盜毋能為也」，及項羽虜秦將王離等鉅鹿下而前，章邯等軍數卻，上書請益助，燕、趙、齊、楚、韓、魏皆立為王，自關以東，大氐盡畔秦吏應諸侯，諸侯咸率其眾西鄉。
translations.literal: Gao previously several times said 'Guan east robbers not able do also', and Xiang Yu captured Qin general Wang Li etc. Julu below and advanced, Zhang Han etc. army several retreats, memorialed requested additional aid, Yan Zhao Qi Chu Han Wei all established as kings, from pass east, greatly all rebelled Qin officials responded feudal lords, feudal lords all led their multitudes west faced.
translations.idiomatic: Gao had previously said several times, 'The robbers east of the pass cannot do anything,' but Xiang Yu captured Qin generals Wang Li and others below Julu and advanced. Zhang Han and others' army retreated several times, memorialized requesting additional aid. Yan, Zhao, Qi, Chu, Han, and Wei all established themselves as kings. From the pass eastward, for the most part all rebelled against Qin officials and responded to the feudal lords. The feudal lords all led their multitudes and faced west.

context.next: 沛公將數萬人已屠武關，使人私於高，高恐二世怒，誅及其身，乃謝病不朝見。

translations.literal: Duke Pei, leading several tens of thousands of people, had already slaughtered Wuguan. He sent someone privately to Gao. Gao feared the Second Emperor would be angered and the execution would reach his person, so he declined illness and did not attend morning audiences.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Pei, leading several tens of thousands of people, had already slaughtered Wuguan. He sent someone privately to Gao. Gao feared the Second Emperor would be angered and the execution would reach his person, so he declined illness and did not attend morning audiences.

translations.literal: The Second Emperor dreamed that a white tiger bit his left trace horse. He killed it; his heart was not happy. He strangely asked for the dream to be interpreted.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor dreamed that a white tiger bit his left trace horse. He killed it; his heart was not happy. He strangely asked for the dream to be interpreted.

translations.idiomatic: The diviner said, 'The Jing River is causing evil.'

translations.literal: The Second Emperor then purified himself at the Wangyi Palace, wished to sacrifice to the Jing, and sank four white horses.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor then purified himself at the Wangyi Palace, wished to sacrifice to the Jing, and sank four white horses.

translations.idiomatic: He sent an envoy to reproach Gao with the robber and bandit matters.

translations.literal: Gao feared, then secretly with his son-in-law Xianyang magistrate Yan Le, his younger brother Zhao Cheng plotted said: 'His Majesty not listens remonstrations, now affairs urgent, wishes return calamity to my clan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao feared, and then secretly plotted with his son-in-law Yan Le, the Xianyang magistrate, and his younger brother Zhao Cheng, saying, 'His Majesty does not listen to remonstrations. Now affairs are urgent; he wishes to return calamity to my clan.

context.previous: 使使責讓高以盜賊事。
context.next: 吾欲易置上，更立公子嬰。

translations.chinese: 吾欲易置上，更立公子嬰。
translations.literal: I wish to change and place His Majesty, and moreover establish Prince Ying.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to change and place His Majesty, and moreover establish Prince Ying.

translations.literal: Zi Ying benevolent frugal, common people all carry his words.'
translations.idiomatic: Zi Ying is benevolent and frugal; the common people all carry his words.'

translations.literal: He made the palace attendant commander as inner response, deceived into making it seem there were great robbers, commanded Le to summon officials and dispatch soldiers, and pursued and robbed Le's mother, placing her in Gao's residence.
translations.idiomatic: He made the palace attendant commander as inner response, deceived into making it seem there were great robbers, commanded Le to summon officials and dispatch soldiers, and pursued and robbed Le's mother, placing her in Gao's residence.

translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Le to lead over a thousand officials and soldiers to the Wangyi Palace hall gate, bound the guard commander's deputy, and said, 'Robbers entered here—why were they not stopped?'

translations.literal: Guard commander said: 'Surrounding huts set soldiers very careful, how obtained robbers dared enter palace?'
translations.idiomatic: The guard commander said, 'The surrounding huts have soldiers set very carefully—how could robbers dare enter the palace?'

translations.literal: Le then beheaded the guard commander, straightaway led the officials and entered, advanced shooting. The gentlemen and eunuchs were greatly startled; some fled, some resisted—the resisters then died. Those who died were several tens of people.
translations.idiomatic: Le then beheaded the guard commander, straightaway led the officials and entered, advanced shooting. The gentlemen and eunuchs were greatly startled; some fled, some resisted—the resisters then died. Those who died were several tens of people.

translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor was angered and summoned his attendants; the attendants were all panicked and disturbed and did not fight.

translations.idiomatic: Beside him there was one eunuch who served and did not dare leave.

translations.literal: Second generation entered inner, said to him: 'You why not early told me?
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor entered within and said to him, 'Why did you not early tell me?

translations.idiomatic: Yan Le advanced and approached the Second Emperor, reproached and said, 'You are arrogant and unrestrained, execute and kill without way. The world together rebels against you; you should make your own plan.'

translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor said, 'Can the Chancellor be seen?'

translations.idiomatic: Le said, 'Not possible.'

context.previous: 二世曰：「丞相可得見否？」
context.next: 二世曰：「吾願得一郡為王。」

translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor said, 'I wish to obtain one commandery to be king.'

translations.literal: Again said: 'Wish be ten thousand households marquis.'
translations.idiomatic: He again said, 'I wish to be a marquis of ten thousand households.'

translations.idiomatic: He said, 'I wish with my wife and children to be common people, comparable to the various princes.'

translations.idiomatic: Yan Le returned and reported to Zhao Gao. Zhao Gao then completely summoned the various ministers and princes, and told them of the circumstances of executing the Second Emperor.

translations.literal: Said: 'Qin former kingdom, beginning emperor ruled world, therefore called emperor.
translations.idiomatic: He said, 'Qin was formerly a kingdom; the First Emperor ruled the world, therefore called emperor.

translations.literal: Proper be king as before, convenient.'
translations.idiomatic: It is proper to be king as before; convenient.'

translations.idiomatic: They established the Second Emperor's elder brother's son, Prince Ying, as Qin king.

translations.idiomatic: They used common people to bury the Second Emperor in the Yichun Park south of Du.

translations.idiomatic: I heard that Zhao Gao then agreed with Chu to extinguish the Qin clan residence and be king in Guanzhong.

translations.idiomatic: Gao had people invite Zi Ying several times, Zi Ying did not go, Gao indeed went himself, saying: 'Clan temple heavy matters, king why not go?'
