translations.literal: Zi Ying then stabbed killed Gao at purification palace, three clans Gao family to display Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zi Ying then stabbed and killed Gao at the purification palace, three-clanned Gao's family to display in Xianyang.

context.previous: 高使人請子嬰數輩，子嬰不行，高果自往，曰：「宗廟重事，王柰何不行？」
context.next: 子嬰為秦王四十六日，楚將沛公破秦軍入武關，遂至霸上，使人約降子嬰。

translations.chinese: 子嬰為秦王四十六日，楚將沛公破秦軍入武關，遂至霸上，使人約降子嬰。
translations.literal: Zi Ying was Qin king forty-six days, Chu general Pei Gong broke Qin army entered Wu Guan, then reached Ba Shang, made person agreed surrender Zi Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Zi Ying was Qin king for forty-six days, Chu general Pei Gong broke the Qin army and entered Wu Guan, then reached Ba Shang, and sent someone to arrange Zi Ying's surrender.

context.previous: 子嬰遂刺殺高於齋宮，三族高家以徇咸陽。
context.next: 子嬰即系頸以組，白馬素車，奉天子璽符，降軹道旁。

translations.chinese: 子嬰即系頸以組，白馬素車，奉天子璽符，降軹道旁。
translations.literal: Zi Ying immediately tied neck with cord, white horse plain carriage, offered emperor seal talisman, surrendered Zhi road side.
translations.idiomatic: Zi Ying immediately tied his neck with a cord, white horse plain carriage, offered the emperor's seal and talisman, surrendered by the side of Zhi road.

context.previous: 子嬰為秦王四十六日，楚將沛公破秦軍入武關，遂至霸上，使人約降子嬰。
context.next: 沛公遂入咸陽，封宮室府庫，還軍霸上。

translations.chinese: 沛公遂入咸陽，封宮室府庫，還軍霸上。
translations.literal: Pei Gong then entered Xianyang, sealed palace chambers treasuries storehouses, returned army Ba Shang.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Gong then entered Xianyang, sealed the palace chambers, treasuries, and storehouses, and returned his army to Ba Shang.

context.previous: 子嬰即系頸以組，白馬素車，奉天子璽符，降軹道旁。
context.next: 居月餘，諸侯兵至，項籍為從長，殺子嬰及秦諸公子宗族。

translations.chinese: 居月餘，諸侯兵至，項籍為從長，殺子嬰及秦諸公子宗族。
translations.literal: Resided month more, feudal lords troops arrived, Xiang Ji was alliance leader, killed Zi Ying and Qin various princes clan residence.
translations.idiomatic: After residing more than a month, the feudal lords' troops arrived, Xiang Ji was the alliance leader, and killed Zi Ying and the Qin various princes and clan residence.

context.previous: 沛公遂入咸陽，封宮室府庫，還軍霸上。
context.next: 遂屠咸陽，燒其宮室，虜其子女，收其珍寶貨財，諸侯共分之。

translations.chinese: 遂屠咸陽，燒其宮室，虜其子女，收其珍寶貨財，諸侯共分之。
translations.literal: Then slaughtered Xianyang, burned its palace chambers, captured its sons daughters, collected its precious treasures goods wealth, feudal lords together divided them.
translations.idiomatic: Then slaughtered Xianyang, burned its palace chambers, captured its sons and daughters, collected its precious treasures, goods, and wealth, which the feudal lords together divided.

context.previous: 居月餘，諸侯兵至，項籍為從長，殺子嬰及秦諸公子宗族。
context.next: 滅秦之後，各分其地為三，名曰雍王、塞王、翟王，號曰三秦。

translations.chinese: 滅秦之後，各分其地為三，名曰雍王、塞王、翟王，號曰三秦。
translations.literal: Extinguished Qin after, each divided its land as three, named Yong king, Sai king, Di king, titled three Qin.
translations.idiomatic: After extinguishing Qin, each divided its land into three, named Yong king, Sai king, Di king, titled the Three Qin.

context.previous: 遂屠咸陽，燒其宮室，虜其子女，收其珍寶貨財，諸侯共分之。
context.next: 項羽為西楚霸王，主命分天下王諸侯，秦竟滅矣。

translations.chinese: 項羽為西楚霸王，主命分天下王諸侯，秦竟滅矣。
translations.literal: Xiang Yu became west Chu overlord king, chief commanded divided world king feudal lords, Qin finally extinguished already.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Yu became the West Chu Overlord King, chiefly commanded the division of the world to enfeoff kings among the feudal lords, and Qin was finally extinguished.

context.previous: 滅秦之後，各分其地為三，名曰雍王、塞王、翟王，號曰三秦。
context.next: 後五年，天下定於漢。

translations.chinese: 後五年，天下定於漢。
translations.literal: Later five years, world settled at Han.
translations.idiomatic: Five years later, the world was settled under Han.

context.previous: 項羽為西楚霸王，主命分天下王諸侯，秦竟滅矣。

translations.chinese: 太史公曰：秦之先伯翳，嘗有勳於唐虞之際，受土賜姓。
translations.literal: Grand Historian says: Qin ancestors Bo Yi, once had merit at Tang Yu between, received land granted surname.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian says: Qin's ancestor Bo Yi once had merit during the time between Tang and Yu, received land and was granted a surname.

context.next: 及殷夏之閒微散。

translations.chinese: 及殷夏之閒微散。
translations.literal: And Yin Xia between slightly scattered.
translations.idiomatic: And between Yin and Xia they slightly scattered.

context.previous: 太史公曰：秦之先伯翳，嘗有勳於唐虞之際，受土賜姓。
context.next: 至周之衰，秦興，邑于西垂。

translations.chinese: 至周之衰，秦興，邑于西垂。
translations.literal: Reached Zhou decline, Qin rose, established city at west border.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou declined, Qin rose and established a city at the western border.

context.previous: 及殷夏之閒微散。
context.next: 自繆公以來，稍蠶食諸侯，竟成始皇。

translations.chinese: 自繆公以來，稍蠶食諸侯，竟成始皇。
translations.literal: From Mu gong since, gradually nibbled feudal lords, finally became beginning emperor.
translations.idiomatic: From Duke Mu onward, they gradually nibbled away at the feudal lords, finally becoming the First Emperor.

context.previous: 至周之衰，秦興，邑于西垂。
context.next: 始皇自以為功過五帝，地廣三王，而羞與之侔。

translations.chinese: 始皇自以為功過五帝，地廣三王，而羞與之侔。
translations.literal: Beginning emperor self thought merit surpassed five emperors, land broad three kings, but ashamed match them.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor himself thought his merit surpassed the Five Emperors, his land broader than the Three Kings, but was ashamed to match them.

context.previous: 自繆公以來，稍蠶食諸侯，竟成始皇。
context.next: 善哉乎賈生推言之也！

translations.chinese: 善哉乎賈生推言之也！
translations.literal: Good indeed Jia Sheng expounded spoke it!
translations.idiomatic: How well Jia Sheng expounded and spoke of it!

context.previous: 始皇自以為功過五帝，地廣三王，而羞與之侔。
context.next: 曰：

translations.chinese: 曰：
translations.literal: Said:
translations.idiomatic: Said:

context.previous: 善哉乎賈生推言之也！

translations.chinese: 秦并兼諸侯山東三十餘郡，繕津關，據險塞，修甲兵而守之。
translations.literal: Qin united annexed feudal lords east mountains thirty more commanderies, repaired ford passes, occupied dangerous barriers, repaired armored soldiers guarded them.
translations.idiomatic: Qin united and annexed the feudal lords east of the mountains in thirty more commanderies, repaired the ford passes, occupied the dangerous barriers, repaired the armored soldiers and guarded them.

context.next: 然陳涉以戍卒散亂之眾數百，奮臂大呼，不用弓戟之兵，鉏櫌白梃，望屋而食，橫行天下。

translations.chinese: 然陳涉以戍卒散亂之眾數百，奮臂大呼，不用弓戟之兵，鉏櫌白梃，望屋而食，橫行天下。
translations.literal: However Chen She with garrison soldiers scattered disordered multitudes several hundred, raised arms great called, not used bow halberd soldiers, hoes rakes white clubs, gazed houses ate, horizontal traveled world.
translations.idiomatic: However Chen She with several hundred scattered and disordered garrison soldiers, raised his arms and called out greatly, not using bow or halberd soldiers, hoes, rakes, white clubs, gazed at houses and ate, horizontally traveled the world.

context.previous: 秦并兼諸侯山東三十餘郡，繕津關，據險塞，修甲兵而守之。
context.next: 秦人阻險不守，關梁不闔，長戟不刺，彊弩不射。

translations.chinese: 秦人阻險不守，關梁不闔，長戟不刺，彊弩不射。
translations.literal: Qin people blocked dangers not guarded, passes bridges not closed, long halberds not stabbed, strong crossbows not shot.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin people did not guard the blocked dangers, did not close the passes and bridges, did not stab with long halberds, did not shoot with strong crossbows.

context.previous: 然陳涉以戍卒散亂之眾數百，奮臂大呼，不用弓戟之兵，鉏櫌白梃，望屋而食，橫行天下。
context.next: 楚師深入，戰於鴻門，曾無藩籬之艱。

translations.chinese: 楚師深入，戰於鴻門，曾無藩籬之艱。
translations.literal: Chu armies deeply entered, battled at Hong Men, once had no fence hedge difficulties.
translations.idiomatic: The Chu armies deeply entered, battled at Hong Men, once had no fence or hedge difficulties.

context.previous: 秦人阻險不守，關梁不闔，長戟不刺，彊弩不射。
context.next: 於是山東大擾，諸侯并起，豪俊相立。

translations.chinese: 於是山東大擾，諸侯并起，豪俊相立。
translations.literal: Thereupon east mountains greatly disturbed, feudal lords together rose, heroes outstanding mutually established.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon east of the mountains was greatly disturbed, the feudal lords together rose, heroes and outstanding men mutually established themselves.

context.previous: 楚師深入，戰於鴻門，曾無藩籬之艱。
context.next: 秦使章邯將而東征，章邯因以三軍之眾要市於外，以謀其上。

translations.chinese: 秦使章邯將而東征，章邯因以三軍之眾要市於外，以謀其上。
translations.literal: Qin made Zhang Han general east campaign, Zhang Han then with three armies multitudes demanded ransom outside, to plot his superiors.
translations.idiomatic: Qin made Zhang Han general for the eastern campaign, Zhang Han then with the multitudes of the three armies demanded ransom outside, to plot against his superiors.

context.previous: 於是山東大擾，諸侯并起，豪俊相立。
context.next: 群臣之不信，可見於此矣。

translations.chinese: 群臣之不信，可見於此矣。
translations.literal: Ministers not trustworthy, can be seen at this already.
translations.idiomatic: That the ministers were not trustworthy can be seen from this.

context.previous: 秦使章邯將而東征，章邯因以三軍之眾要市於外，以謀其上。
context.next: 子嬰立，遂不寤。

translations.chinese: 子嬰立，遂不寤。
translations.literal: Zi Ying established, then not awoke.
translations.idiomatic: Zi Ying was established, then did not awaken.

context.previous: 群臣之不信，可見於此矣。
context.next: 藉使子嬰有庸主之材，僅得中佐，山東雖亂，秦之地可全而有，宗廟之祀未當絕也。

translations.chinese: 藉使子嬰有庸主之材，僅得中佐，山東雖亂，秦之地可全而有，宗廟之祀未當絕也。
translations.literal: Suppose Zi Ying had ordinary lord materials, merely obtained middle assistants, east mountains though chaotic, Qin land could whole have, clan temple sacrifices not should extinguished also.
translations.idiomatic: Suppose Zi Ying had the materials of an ordinary lord, merely obtained middle assistants, east of the mountains though chaotic, Qin land could be wholly preserved, clan temple sacrifices should not have been extinguished.

context.previous: 子嬰立，遂不寤。

translations.chinese: 秦地被山帶河以為固，四塞之國也。
translations.literal: Qin land covered mountains girded rivers as solid, four barriers country also.
translations.idiomatic: Qin land was covered by mountains and girded by rivers as solid, a country of four barriers.

context.next: 自繆公以來，至於秦王，二十餘君，常為諸侯雄。

translations.chinese: 自繆公以來，至於秦王，二十餘君，常為諸侯雄。
translations.literal: From Mu gong since, reached Qin king, twenty more lords, constantly were feudal lords hero.
translations.idiomatic: From Duke Mu onward, reaching the Qin king, twenty more lords constantly were the hero of the feudal lords.

context.previous: 秦地被山帶河以為固，四塞之國也。
context.next: 豈世世賢哉？

translations.chinese: 豈世世賢哉？
translations.literal: How generation generation worthy ah?
translations.idiomatic: How could generation after generation be worthy?

context.previous: 自繆公以來，至於秦王，二十餘君，常為諸侯雄。
context.next: 其勢居然也。

translations.chinese: 其勢居然也。
translations.literal: Their situation obviously also.
translations.idiomatic: Their situation was obviously so.

context.previous: 豈世世賢哉？
context.next: 且天下嘗同心并力而攻秦矣。

translations.chinese: 且天下嘗同心并力而攻秦矣。
translations.literal: Moreover world once united hearts united strength attacked Qin already.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the world once united hearts and united strength to attack Qin.

context.previous: 其勢居然也。
context.next: 當此之世，賢智并列，良將行其師，賢相通其謀，然困於阻險而不能進，秦乃延入戰而為之開關，百萬之徒逃北而遂壞。

translations.chinese: 當此之世，賢智并列，良將行其師，賢相通其謀，然困於阻險而不能進，秦乃延入戰而為之開關，百萬之徒逃北而遂壞。
translations.literal: At this time, worthy wise parallel arrayed, good generals marched their armies, worthy chancellors communicated their plans, however trapped by blocked dangers could not advance, Qin then lured them battle opened passes, million multitudes fled north then destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, the worthy and wise were arrayed in parallel, good generals marched their armies, worthy chancellors communicated their plans, however they were trapped by blocked dangers and could not advance, Qin then lured them into battle and opened the passes for them, million multitudes fled north and were then destroyed.

context.previous: 且天下嘗同心并力而攻秦矣。
context.next: 豈勇力智慧不足哉？

translations.chinese: 豈勇力智慧不足哉？
translations.literal: How courage strength wisdom insufficient ah?
translations.idiomatic: How could courage, strength, and wisdom be insufficient?

context.previous: 當此之世，賢智并列，良將行其師，賢相通其謀，然困於阻險而不能進，秦乃延入戰而為之開關，百萬之徒逃北而遂壞。
context.next: 形不利，勢不便也。

translations.chinese: 形不利，勢不便也。
translations.literal: Form unfavorable, situation inconvenient also.
translations.idiomatic: The form was unfavorable, the situation inconvenient.

context.previous: 豈勇力智慧不足哉？
context.next: 秦小邑并大城，守險塞而軍，高壘毋戰，閉關據阨，荷戟而守之。

translations.chinese: 秦小邑并大城，守險塞而軍，高壘毋戰，閉關據阨，荷戟而守之。
translations.literal: Qin small cities united large cities, guarded dangerous barriers stationed armies, high ramparts not battle, closed passes occupied defiles, carried halberds guarded them.
translations.idiomatic: Qin united small cities into large cities, guarded the dangerous barriers and stationed armies, high ramparts did not battle, closed passes occupied defiles, carried halberds and guarded them.

context.previous: 形不利，勢不便也。
context.next: 諸侯起於匹夫，以利合，非有素王之行也。

translations.chinese: 諸侯起於匹夫，以利合，非有素王之行也。
translations.literal: Feudal lords rose from common men, with profit united, not had prepared king conduct also.
translations.idiomatic: The feudal lords rose from common men, united by profit, did not have the conduct of prepared kings.

context.previous: 秦小邑并大城，守險塞而軍，高壘毋戰，閉關據阨，荷戟而守之。
context.next: 其交未親，其下未附，名為亡秦，其實利之也。

translations.chinese: 其交未親，其下未附，名為亡秦，其實利之也。
translations.literal: Their relations not close, their below not attached, named perished Qin, actually profited it also.
translations.idiomatic: Their relations were not close, their subordinates not attached, named perished Qin, actually profited from it.

context.previous: 諸侯起於匹夫，以利合，非有素王之行也。
context.next: 彼見秦阻之難犯也，必退師。

translations.chinese: 彼見秦阻之難犯也，必退師。
translations.literal: They saw Qin barriers difficult violate also, certainly retreated armies.
translations.idiomatic: They saw that Qin's barriers were difficult to violate, certainly retreated their armies.

context.previous: 其交未親，其下未附，名為亡秦，其實利之也。
context.next: 安土息民，以待其敝，收弱扶罷，以令大國之君，不患不得意於海內。

translations.chinese: 安土息民，以待其敝，收弱扶罷，以令大國之君，不患不得意於海內。
translations.literal: Pacified land rested people, to await their exhaustion, gathered weak supported tired, to command great countries lords, not worried not obtained intention within seas.
translations.idiomatic: Pacified the land and rested the people, to await their exhaustion, gathered the weak and supported the tired, to command the lords of great countries, not worried about not obtaining intention within the seas.

context.previous: 彼見秦阻之難犯也，必退師。
context.next: 貴為天子，富有天下，而身為禽者，其救敗非也。

translations.chinese: 貴為天子，富有天下，而身為禽者，其救敗非也。
translations.literal: Noble as emperor, rich had world, but body became prey ones, their rescue defeat wrong also.
translations.idiomatic: Though noble as emperor and rich with the world, their bodies became prey—their rescue of defeat was wrong.

context.previous: 安土息民，以待其敝，收弱扶罷，以令大國之君，不患不得意於海內。

translations.chinese: 秦王足己不問，遂過而不變。
translations.literal: Qin king satisfied self not asked, then erred not changed.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin king was satisfied with himself and did not ask, then erred and did not change.

context.next: 二世受之，因而不改，暴虐以重禍。

translations.chinese: 二世受之，因而不改，暴虐以重禍。
translations.literal: Second generation received it, followed not changed, violent cruel to increase calamities.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor received it, followed without changing, violent and cruel to increase calamities.

context.previous: 秦王足己不問，遂過而不變。
context.next: 子嬰孤立無親，危弱無輔。

translations.chinese: 子嬰孤立無親，危弱無輔。
translations.literal: Zi Ying isolated no relatives, dangerous weak no assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Zi Ying was isolated without relatives, dangerous and weak without assistants.

context.previous: 二世受之，因而不改，暴虐以重禍。
context.next: 三主惑而終身不悟，亡，不亦宜乎？

translations.chinese: 三主惑而終身不悟，亡，不亦宜乎？
translations.literal: Three lords confused lifelong not awoke, perished, not also proper ah?
translations.idiomatic: The three lords were confused and lifelong did not awaken, perished—was this not proper?

context.previous: 子嬰孤立無親，危弱無輔。
context.next: 當此時也，世非無深慮知化之士也，然所以不敢盡忠拂過者，秦俗多忌諱之禁，忠言未卒於口而身為戮沒矣。

translations.chinese: 當此時也，世非無深慮知化之士也，然所以不敢盡忠拂過者，秦俗多忌諱之禁，忠言未卒於口而身為戮沒矣。
translations.literal: At this time, world not without deep thought knew change scholars also, however what dared not exhaust loyalty opposed faults ones, Qin customs many taboo prohibitions, loyal words not finished in mouth body became executed drowned already.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, the world was not without scholars of deep thought who knew change, however those who dared not exhaust loyalty and oppose faults, Qin customs had many taboo prohibitions—loyal words were not finished in the mouth when the body became executed and drowned.

context.previous: 三主惑而終身不悟，亡，不亦宜乎？
context.next: 故使天下之士，傾耳而聽，重足而立，拑口而不言。

translations.chinese: 故使天下之士，傾耳而聽，重足而立，拑口而不言。
translations.literal: Therefore made world scholars, inclined ears listened, heavy feet stood, shut mouths not spoke.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore it made the world's scholars incline their ears and listen, stand with heavy feet, shut their mouths and not speak.

context.previous: 當此時也，世非無深慮知化之士也，然所以不敢盡忠拂過者，秦俗多忌諱之禁，忠言未卒於口而身為戮沒矣。
context.next: 是以三主失道，忠臣不敢諫，智士不敢謀，天下已亂，姦不上聞，豈不哀哉！

translations.chinese: 是以三主失道，忠臣不敢諫，智士不敢謀，天下已亂，姦不上聞，豈不哀哉！
translations.literal: Therefore three lords lost way, loyal ministers not dared remonstrate, wise scholars not dared plan, world already chaotic, evil not up heard, how not sorrowful ah!
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the three rulers lost the way; loyal ministers dared not remonstrate, wise men dared not plan. The world was already in chaos, evil was not reported upward—how could this not be sorrowful!

context.previous: 故使天下之士，傾耳而聽，重足而立，拑口而不言。
context.next: 先王知雍蔽之傷國也，故置公卿大夫士，以飾法設刑，而天下治。

translations.chinese: 先王知雍蔽之傷國也，故置公卿大夫士，以飾法設刑，而天下治。
translations.literal: Former kings knew that blocking and obstructing harmed the country, therefore they established nobles, grand masters, and scholars to adorn the laws and set punishments, and the world was governed.
translations.idiomatic: Former kings knew that blocking and obstructing harmed the country, therefore they established nobles, grand masters, and scholars to adorn the laws and set punishments, and the world was governed.

context.previous: 是以三主失道，忠臣不敢諫，智士不敢謀，天下已亂，姦不上聞，豈不哀哉！
context.next: 其彊也，禁暴誅亂而天下服。

translations.chinese: 其彊也，禁暴誅亂而天下服。
translations.literal: When they were strong, they prohibited violence, executed chaos, and the world submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When they were strong, they prohibited violence, executed chaos, and the world submitted.

context.previous: 先王知雍蔽之傷國也，故置公卿大夫士，以飾法設刑，而天下治。
context.next: 其弱也，五伯征而諸侯從。

translations.chinese: 其弱也，五伯征而諸侯從。
translations.literal: When they were weak, the Five Hegemons campaigned and the feudal lords followed.
translations.idiomatic: When they were weak, the Five Hegemons campaigned and the feudal lords followed.

context.previous: 其彊也，禁暴誅亂而天下服。
context.next: 其削也，內守外附而社稷存。

translations.chinese: 其削也，內守外附而社稷存。
translations.literal: When they were reduced, they guarded internally and attached externally, and the altars of soil and grain were preserved.
translations.idiomatic: When they were reduced, they guarded internally and attached externally, and the altars of soil and grain were preserved.

context.previous: 其弱也，五伯征而諸侯從。
context.next: 故秦之盛也，繁法嚴刑而天下振；

translations.chinese: 故秦之盛也，繁法嚴刑而天下振；
translations.literal: Therefore Qin prosperity also, numerous laws strict punishments and world shook;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when Qin prospered, numerous laws and strict punishments shook the world;

context.previous: 其削也，內守外附而社稷存。
context.next: 及其衰也，百姓怨望而海內畔矣。

translations.chinese: 及其衰也，百姓怨望而海內畔矣。
translations.literal: when it declined, the common people resented and hoped, and within the seas they rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: When it declined, the common people resented and hoped, and within the seas they rebelled.

context.previous: 故秦之盛也，繁法嚴刑而天下振；
context.next: 故周五序得其道，而千餘歲不絕。

translations.chinese: 故周五序得其道，而千餘歲不絕。
translations.literal: Sad indeed! What made the Qin house lose the world was none other than the laws being too dense and punishments too severe.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Zhou, through the Five Orders, obtained the way, and more than a thousand years did not end.

context.previous: 及其衰也，百姓怨望而海內畔矣。
context.next: 秦本末并失，故不長久。

translations.chinese: 秦本末并失，故不長久。
translations.literal: Although the First Emperor unified the world with strength, he did not change the Qin customs.
translations.idiomatic: Qin lost both root and branch, therefore did not last long.

context.previous: 故周五序得其道，而千餘歲不絕。
context.next: 由此觀之，安危之統相去遠矣。

translations.chinese: 由此觀之，安危之統相去遠矣。
translations.literal: The Second Emperor followed the same path, increasing the oppression.
translations.idiomatic: From this it can be seen that the principles of safety and danger are far apart.

context.previous: 秦本末并失，故不長久。
context.next: 野諺曰「前事之不忘，後事之師也」。

translations.chinese: 野諺曰「前事之不忘，後事之師也」。
translations.literal: Rural proverb said 'former matters not forget, later matters teacher also'.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the people could not bear it and rose up together.

context.previous: 由此觀之，安危之統相去遠矣。
context.next: 是以君子為國，觀之上古，驗之當世，參以人事，察盛衰之理，審權勢之宜，去就有序，變化有時，故曠日長久而社稷安矣。

translations.chinese: 是以君子為國，觀之上古，驗之當世，參以人事，察盛衰之理，審權勢之宜，去就有序，變化有時，故曠日長久而社稷安矣。
translations.literal: This is like tying a tiger with a rope and then releasing it—how could it not be dangerous?
translations.idiomatic: Therefore gentlemen governing the country observe the highest antiquity, verify in the present age, consult with human affairs, observe the principles of flourishing and decline, carefully consider the appropriateness of power and influence, depart and remain in order, change at the proper time, therefore days are broad and long and the altars of soil and grain are secure.

context.previous: 野諺曰「前事之不忘，後事之師也」。

translations.chinese: 秦孝公據殽函之固，擁雍州之地，君臣固守而窺周室，有席卷天下，包舉宇內，囊括四海之意，并吞八荒之心。
translations.literal: Qin Xiao gong occupied the Xiao and Han defiles as solid fortifications, embracing Yong province lands, with ruler and ministers firmly guarding and spying on Zhou quarters, having the intent to roll up the world, wrap the universe within, encompass the four seas, and unite and swallow the eight wastes.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Duke Xiao occupied the Xiao and Han defiles as solid fortifications, embracing Yong province lands, with ruler and ministers firmly guarding and spying on Zhou quarters, having the intent to roll up the world, wrap the universe within, encompass the four seas, and unite and swallow the eight wastes.

context.next: 當是時，商君佐之，內立法度，務耕織，修守戰之備，外連衡而鬬諸侯，於是秦人拱手而取西河之外。

translations.chinese: 當是時，商君佐之，內立法度，務耕織，修守戰之備，外連衡而鬬諸侯，於是秦人拱手而取西河之外。
translations.literal: When the time came, Duke Xiao died, King Huiwen ascended, and Duke Zhang became chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, Shang Jun assisted him, internally establishing laws and measures, diligently farming and weaving, repairing defenses for guarding and warfare, externally connecting horizontally and fighting the feudal lords. Thereupon the Qin people took beyond the West River with folded hands.

context.previous: 秦孝公據殽函之固，擁雍州之地，君臣固守而窺周室，有席卷天下，包舉宇內，囊括四海之意，并吞八荒之心。

translations.chinese: 孝公既沒，惠王、武王蒙故業，因遺冊，南兼漢中，西舉巴、蜀，東割膏腴之地，收要害之郡。
translations.literal: Zhang and Xiao together planned to attack Zhou, and Zhou was terrified.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xiao having died, King Hui and King Wu inherited the old enterprise, following the bequeathed strategies, south uniting Hanzhong, west taking Ba and Shu, east cutting rich and fertile lands, collecting key strategic commanderies.

context.next: 諸侯恐懼，會盟而謀弱秦，不愛珍器重寶肥美之地，以致天下之士，合從締交，相與為一。

translations.chinese: 諸侯恐懼，會盟而謀弱秦，不愛珍器重寶肥美之地，以致天下之士，合從締交，相與為一。
translations.literal: At this time, Qi had Meng Chang, Zhao had Ping Yuan, Chu had Chun Shen, Wei had Xin Ling.
translations.idiomatic: The feudal lords feared, assembled and allied to plan weakening Qin, not sparing precious vessels, heavy treasures, or fertile lands, to attract the world's scholars, allied together, established relations, mutually became one.

context.previous: 孝公既沒，惠王、武王蒙故業，因遺冊，南兼漢中，西舉巴、蜀，東割膏腴之地，收要害之郡。
context.next: 當是時，齊有孟嘗，趙有平原，楚有春申，魏有信陵。

translations.chinese: 當是時，齊有孟嘗，趙有平原，楚有春申，魏有信陵。
translations.literal: This was the beginning of the Four Gentlemen of the Warring States.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, Qi had Meng Chang, Zhao had Ping Yuan, Chu had Chun Shen, Wei had Xin Ling.

context.previous: 諸侯恐懼，會盟而謀弱秦，不愛珍器重寶肥美之地，以致天下之士，合從締交，相與為一。
context.next: 此四君者，皆明知而忠信，寬厚而愛人，尊賢重士，約從離衡，并韓、魏、燕、楚、齊、趙、宋、衛、中山之眾。

translations.chinese: 此四君者，皆明知而忠信，寬厚而愛人，尊賢重士，約從離衡，并韓、魏、燕、楚、齊、趙、宋、衛、中山之眾。
translations.literal: Therefore the world called them the Four Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: These four lords were all bright in knowledge and faithful in trust, broad and thick loving people, honoring worthy and valuing scholars, allied together separating balances, united Han, Wei, Yan, Chu, Qi, Zhao, Song, Wei, Zhongshan multitudes.

context.previous: 當是時，齊有孟嘗，趙有平原，楚有春申，魏有信陵。
context.next: 於是六國之士有寧越、徐尚、蘇秦、杜赫之屬為之謀，齊明、周最、陳軫、昭滑、樓緩、翟景、蘇厲、樂毅之徒通其意，吳起、孫臏、帶佗、兒良、王廖、田忌、廉頗、趙奢之朋制其兵。

translations.chinese: 於是六國之士有寧越、徐尚、蘇秦、杜赫之屬為之謀，齊明、周最、陳軫、昭滑、樓緩、翟景、蘇厲、樂毅之徒通其意，吳起、孫臏、帶佗、兒良、王廖、田忌、廉頗、趙奢之朋制其兵。
translations.literal: Duke Xiao was benevolent and his virtue was abundant; he was fond of the people and benefited the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the six states' scholars had Ning Yue, Xu Shang, Su Qin, Du He and others planning for them, Qi Ming, Zhou Zui, Chen Zhen, Zhao Hua, Lou Huan, Di Jing, Su Li, Yue Yi and others communicating their intentions, Wu Qi, Sun Bin, Dai Tuo, Er Liang, Wang Liao, Tian Ji, Lian Po, Zhao She companions controlling their armies.

context.previous: 此四君者，皆明知而忠信，寬厚而愛人，尊賢重士，約從離衡，并韓、魏、燕、楚、齊、趙、宋、衛、中山之眾。
context.next: 常以十倍之地，百萬之眾，叩關而攻秦。

translations.chinese: 常以十倍之地，百萬之眾，叩關而攻秦。
translations.literal: He welcomed wandering scholars and gathered able men; the Qin lands were enriched.
translations.idiomatic: Constantly with ten times the land, million multitudes, knocking on the passes attacking Qin.

context.previous: 於是六國之士有寧越、徐尚、蘇秦、杜赫之屬為之謀，齊明、周最、陳軫、昭滑、樓緩、翟景、蘇厲、樂毅之徒通其意，吳起、孫臏、帶佗、兒良、王廖、田忌、廉頗、趙奢之朋制其兵。
context.next: 秦人開關延敵，九國之師逡巡遁逃而不敢進。

translations.chinese: 秦人開關延敵，九國之師逡巡遁逃而不敢進。
translations.literal: He moved the capital to Xianyang and made the laws strict.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin people opened passes lured enemies, nine countries armies hesitant fled escaped dared not advance.

context.previous: 常以十倍之地，百萬之眾，叩關而攻秦。
context.next: 秦無亡矢遺鏃之費，而天下諸侯已困矣。

translations.chinese: 秦無亡矢遺鏃之費，而天下諸侯已困矣。
translations.literal: Duke Xiao died and was buried at Yong, called Duke Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: Qin had no lost arrow abandoned arrowhead expenditures, but world feudal lords already exhausted.

context.previous: 秦人開關延敵，九國之師逡巡遁逃而不敢進。
context.next: 於是從散約解，爭割地而奉秦。

translations.chinese: 於是從散約解，爭割地而奉秦。
translations.literal: Duke Huiwen succeeded him, called King Huiwen.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon alliances scattered agreements dissolved, contended to cut lands presented to Qin.

context.previous: 秦無亡矢遺鏃之費，而天下諸侯已困矣。
context.next: 秦有餘力而制其敝，追亡逐北，伏尸百萬，流血漂鹵。

translations.chinese: 秦有餘力而制其敝，追亡逐北，伏尸百萬，流血漂鹵。
translations.literal: King Huiwen was ambitious and martial; he first established the title of king.
translations.idiomatic: Qin had surplus strength controlled their exhaustion, pursued fleeing drove defeated, prostrate corpses hundred thousand, flowing blood floated shields.

context.previous: 於是從散約解，爭割地而奉秦。
context.next: 因利乘便，宰割天下，分裂河山，彊國請服，弱國入朝。

translations.chinese: 因利乘便，宰割天下，分裂河山，彊國請服，弱國入朝。
translations.literal: He attacked the Rong barbarians and extended the Qin borders.
translations.idiomatic: Taking advantage of benefits, riding convenience, butchering the world, splitting rivers and mountains, strong countries requested submission, weak countries entered court.

context.previous: 秦有餘力而制其敝，追亡逐北，伏尸百萬，流血漂鹵。
context.next: 延及孝文王、莊襄王，享國日淺，國家無事。

translations.chinese: 延及孝文王、莊襄王，享國日淺，國家無事。
translations.literal: He attacked Shu and established Shu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Extended to King Xiao Wen, King Zhuang Xiang, enjoyed country days shallow, state had no affairs.

context.previous: 因利乘便，宰割天下，分裂河山，彊國請服，弱國入朝。

translations.chinese: 及至秦王，續六世之餘烈，振長策而御宇內，吞二周而亡諸侯，履至尊而制六合，執棰拊以鞭笞天下，威振四海。
translations.literal: He captured Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Reached Qin king, continued six generations remaining achievements, shook long plans controlled universe within, swallowed two Zhou perished feudal lords, trod supreme controlled six directions, held cane stroked lashed world, might shook four seas.

context.next: 南取百越之地，以為桂林、象郡，百越之君俛首系頸，委命下吏。

translations.chinese: 南取百越之地，以為桂林、象郡，百越之君俛首系頸，委命下吏。
translations.literal: He attacked the three Jin states.
translations.idiomatic: South took Baiyue lands, made Guilin, Xiang commandery, Baiyue lords bowed heads bound necks, entrusted fate lower officials.

context.previous: 及至秦王，續六世之餘烈，振長策而御宇內，吞二周而亡諸侯，履至尊而制六合，執棰拊以鞭笞天下，威振四海。
context.next: 乃使蒙恬北筑長城而守藩籬，卻匈奴七百餘里，胡人不敢南下而牧馬，士不敢彎弓而報怨。

translations.chinese: 乃使蒙恬北筑長城而守藩籬，卻匈奴七百餘里，胡人不敢南下而牧馬，士不敢彎弓而報怨。
translations.literal: He destroyed the state of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Then made Meng Tian north build long wall guarded border fence, drove Xiongnu seven hundred more li, Hu people dared not south descend pasture horses, archers dared not bend bows repay grievances.

context.previous: 南取百越之地，以為桂林、象郡，百越之君俛首系頸，委命下吏。
context.next: 於是廢先王之道，焚百家之言，以愚黔首。

translations.chinese: 於是廢先王之道，焚百家之言，以愚黔首。
translations.literal: He attacked Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon abolished former kings way, burned hundred schools words, to foolish commoners.

context.previous: 乃使蒙恬北筑長城而守藩籬，卻匈奴七百餘里，胡人不敢南下而牧馬，士不敢彎弓而報怨。
context.next: 墮名城，殺豪俊，收天下之兵聚之咸陽，銷鋒鑄鐻，以為金人十二，以弱黔首之民。

translations.chinese: 墮名城，殺豪俊，收天下之兵聚之咸陽，銷鋒鑄鐻，以為金人十二，以弱黔首之民。
translations.literal: He took the Shangdang lands.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed famous cities, killed outstanding men, gathered the world's weapons in Xianyang, melted away the blades and cast bells, and made twelve golden men to weaken the common people.

context.previous: 於是廢先王之道，焚百家之言，以愚黔首。
context.next: 然後斬華為城，因河為津，據億丈之城，臨不測之谿以為固。

translations.chinese: 然後斬華為城，因河為津，據億丈之城，臨不測之谿以為固。
translations.literal: He attacked Hann and captured Yique.
translations.idiomatic: Then he carved out a city at Hua, used the river as a ford, occupied walls a hundred zhang high, and used unfathomable ravines as fortifications.

context.previous: 墮名城，殺豪俊，收天下之兵聚之咸陽，銷鋒鑄鐻，以為金人十二，以弱黔首之民。
context.next: 良將勁弩守要害之處，信臣精卒陳利兵而誰何，天下以定。

translations.chinese: 良將勁弩守要害之處，信臣精卒陳利兵而誰何，天下以定。
translations.literal: He attacked Zhao and captured Guanglang.
translations.idiomatic: Elite generals and strong crossbowmen guarded the key points, while faithful ministers and elite soldiers stood arrayed with sharp weapons to challenge any who came; thus the world was settled.

context.previous: 然後斬華為城，因河為津，據億丈之城，臨不測之谿以為固。
context.next: 秦王之心，自以為關中之固，金城千里，子孫帝王萬世之業也。

translations.chinese: 秦王之心，自以為關中之固，金城千里，子孫帝王萬世之業也。
translations.literal: He attacked Wei and captured the Yellow River bend.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin king believed Guanzhong was as secure as a fortress, a golden city a thousand li wide, an enterprise for imperial descendants for ten thousand generations.

context.previous: 良將勁弩守要害之處，信臣精卒陳利兵而誰何，天下以定。

translations.chinese: 秦王既沒，餘威振於殊俗。
translations.literal: He attacked Hann and Wei, defeating them at the River Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Qin king having died, remaining might shook different customs.

context.next: 陳涉，罋牖繩樞之子，甿隸之人，而遷徙之徒，才能不及中人，非有仲尼、墨翟之賢，陶朱、猗頓之富，躡足行伍之閒，而倔起什伯之中，率罷散之卒，將數百之眾，而轉攻秦。

translations.chinese: 陳涉，罋牖繩樞之子，甿隸之人，而遷徙之徒，才能不及中人，非有仲尼、墨翟之賢，陶朱、猗頓之富，躡足行伍之閒，而倔起什伯之中，率罷散之卒，將數百之眾，而轉攻秦。
translations.literal: He captured the two generals Meng Ao and Wang Ling.
translations.idiomatic: Chen She was the son of a poor peasant family, a common laborer and migrant who lacked the talents of ordinary men, let alone the worth of Confucius or Mozi or the wealth of Tao Zhu and Yi Dun. Yet he rose from the ranks with the lowest troops, led a few hundred men, and turned to attack Qin.

context.previous: 秦王既沒，餘威振於殊俗。
context.next: 斬木為兵，揭竿為旗，天下雲集響應，贏糧而景從，山東豪俊遂并起而亡秦族矣。

translations.chinese: 斬木為兵，揭竿為旗，天下雲集響應，贏糧而景從，山東豪俊遂并起而亡秦族矣。
translations.literal: He destroyed the state of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: They cut wood for weapons and raised poles for flags. The world gathered like clouds in response, carrying grain and following like a shadow, and the heroes of the eastern states rose together and destroyed the Qin house.

context.previous: 陳涉，罋牖繩樞之子，甿隸之人，而遷徙之徒，才能不及中人，非有仲尼、墨翟之賢，陶朱、猗頓之富，躡足行伍之閒，而倔起什伯之中，率罷散之卒，將數百之眾，而轉攻秦。

translations.chinese: 且夫天下非小弱也，雍州之地，殽函之固自若也。
translations.literal: He attacked Zhao, defeating them at Changping, killing 400,000 men.
translations.idiomatic: The world was not weak and small; the land of Yongzhou and the strength of Xiaohan remained as before.

context.next: 陳涉之位，非尊於齊、楚、燕、趙、韓、魏、宋、衛、中山之君；

translations.chinese: 陳涉之位，非尊於齊、楚、燕、趙、韓、魏、宋、衛、中山之君；
translations.literal: Chen She position, not honored Qi Chu Yan Zhao Han Wei Song Wei Zhong Shan lords;
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Hann, capturing Yangcheng and Yinjing.

context.previous: 且夫天下非小弱也，雍州之地，殽函之固自若也。
context.next: 鉏櫌棘矜，非錟於句戟長鎩也；

translations.chinese: 鉏櫌棘矜，非錟於句戟長鎩也；
translations.literal: Hoe rake thorn shafts, not sharper hooked halberds long spears also;
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Wei, capturing Yuan and Xingqiu.

context.previous: 陳涉之位，非尊於齊、楚、燕、趙、韓、魏、宋、衛、中山之君；
context.next: 適戍之眾，非抗於九國之師；

translations.chinese: 適戍之眾，非抗於九國之師；
translations.literal: Suitable garrison multitudes, not matched nine states armies;
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Zhao, capturing Zhao cities.

context.previous: 鉏櫌棘矜，非錟於句戟長鎩也；

translations.idiomatic: If the Second Emperor had behaved like an ordinary ruler and employed the loyal and worthy, if ruler and ministers had united in concern for the troubles within the seas, if he had worn plain clothes to correct the First Emperor's errors, divided land and people among meritorious descendants, established states and lords to govern the world properly, emptied prisons and lifted punishments, removed the guilt of collected arrears and filth, sent each back to his village, opened the granaries and distributed wealth and goods to aid orphans, widows, the poor, and the destitute, lightened taxes and reduced demands to ease the people's burden, simplified the laws and reduced punishments, and let the people renew themselves and reform their conduct, then the world would have gathered around him.

translations.chinese: 獻公立七年，初行為市。
translations.literal: In Duke Xian's seventh year of establishment, initially acted as market.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Duke Xian's reign, markets were first established.

context.next: 十年，為戶籍相伍。

translations.chinese: 十年，為戶籍相伍。
translations.literal: In the tenth year, made household registers mutually five.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, a system of household registration in groups of five was established.

context.previous: 獻公立七年，初行為市。

translations.chinese: 孝公立十六年。
translations.literal: Duke Xiao established the sixteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: In Duke Xiao's sixteenth year.

context.next: 時桃李冬華。

translations.chinese: 時桃李冬華。
translations.literal: At this time the peach and plum winter flowered.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, peaches and plums bloomed in winter.

context.previous: 孝公立十六年。

translations.chinese: 惠文王生十九年而立。
translations.literal: King Huiwen was born nineteen years then established.
translations.idiomatic: King Huiwen ascended the throne at nineteen years of age.

context.next: 立二年，初行錢。

translations.chinese: 立二年，初行錢。
translations.literal: In the second year of his establishment, initially circulated money.
translations.idiomatic: In his second year on the throne, coinage was first introduced.

context.previous: 惠文王生十九年而立。
context.next: 有新生嬰兒曰「秦且王」。

translations.chinese: 有新生嬰兒曰「秦且王」。
translations.literal: A newborn infant was said to be 'Qin will yet reign.'
translations.idiomatic: A newborn infant was said to portend that Qin would yet reign.

context.previous: 立二年，初行錢。

translations.chinese: 悼武王生十九年而立。
translations.literal: King Daowu was born nineteen years then established.
translations.idiomatic: King Daowu ascended the throne at nineteen years of age.

context.next: 立三年，渭水赤三日。

translations.chinese: 立三年，渭水赤三日。
translations.literal: In the third year of his establishment, the Wei River was red for three days.
translations.idiomatic: In his third year on the throne, the Wei River ran red for three days.

context.previous: 悼武王生十九年而立。

translations.chinese: 昭襄王生十九年而立。
translations.literal: King Zhaoxiang was born nineteen years then established.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhaoxiang ascended the throne at nineteen years of age.

context.next: 立四年，初為田開阡陌。

translations.chinese: 立四年，初為田開阡陌。
translations.literal: In the fourth year of his establishment, initially for fields opened paths and boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: In his fourth year on the throne, the well-field system was first abolished, opening up the paths and boundaries between fields.

context.previous: 昭襄王生十九年而立。

translations.chinese: 孝文王生五十三年而立。
translations.literal: King Xiaowen was born fifty-three years then established.
translations.idiomatic: King Xiaowen ascended the throne at fifty-three years of age.

translations.chinese: 莊襄王生三十二年而立。
translations.literal: King Zhuangxiang was born thirty-two years then established.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhuangxiang ascended the throne at thirty-two years of age.

context.next: 立二年，取太原地。

translations.chinese: 立二年，取太原地。
translations.literal: In the second year of his establishment, took Taiyuan territory.
translations.idiomatic: In his second year on the throne, he conquered the territory of Taiyuan.

context.previous: 莊襄王生三十二年而立。
context.next: 莊襄王元年，大赦，修先王功臣，施德厚骨肉，布惠於民。

translations.chinese: 莊襄王元年，大赦，修先王功臣，施德厚骨肉，布惠於民。
translations.literal: In King Zhuangxiang's first year, great amnesty, honored former kings' meritorious ministers, bestowed virtue generously on relatives, spread favor among the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of King Zhuangxiang's reign, there was a general amnesty. He honored the meritorious ministers of previous kings, treated his relatives with generous virtue, and spread benevolence among the people.

context.previous: 立二年，取太原地。
context.next: 東周與諸侯謀秦，秦使相國不韋誅之，盡入其國。

translations.chinese: 東周與諸侯謀秦，秦使相國不韋誅之，盡入其國。
translations.literal: Eastern Zhou conspired with the feudal lords against Qin, Qin sent Chancellor Lü Buwei to execute him, completely annexed his state.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Zhou conspired with the other feudal lords against Qin. Qin dispatched Chancellor Lü Buwei to execute their ruler and completely absorbed his territory.

context.previous: 莊襄王元年，大赦，修先王功臣，施德厚骨肉，布惠於民。
context.next: 秦不絕其祀，以陽人地賜周君，奉其祭祀。

translations.chinese: 秦不絕其祀，以陽人地賜周君，奉其祭祀。
translations.literal: Qin did not cut off his sacrifices, with Yangren territory granted the Lord of Zhou, to continue his ancestral rites.
translations.idiomatic: Qin did not extinguish his lineage, granting the Lord of Zhou territory in Yangren to maintain his ancestral sacrifices.

context.previous: 東周與諸侯謀秦，秦使相國不韋誅之，盡入其國。

translations.chinese: 始皇享國三十七年。
translations.literal: The First Emperor enjoyed the state for thirty-seven years.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor reigned for thirty-seven years.

context.next: 葬酈邑。

translations.chinese: 葬酈邑。
translations.literal: Buried in Liyi.
translations.idiomatic: He was buried in Liyi.

context.previous: 始皇享國三十七年。
context.next: 生二世皇帝。

translations.chinese: 生二世皇帝。
translations.literal: [The First Emperor] gave birth to the Second Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor was born to him.

context.previous: 葬酈邑。
context.next: 始皇生十三年而立。

translations.chinese: 始皇生十三年而立。
translations.literal: The First Emperor was born thirteen years then established.
translations.idiomatic: The First Emperor ascended the throne at thirteen years of age.

context.previous: 生二世皇帝。

translations.chinese: 二世皇帝享國三年。
translations.literal: The Second Emperor enjoyed the state for three years.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor reigned for three years.

context.next: 葬宜春。

translations.chinese: 葬宜春。
translations.literal: Buried at Yichun.
translations.idiomatic: He was buried at Yichun.

context.previous: 二世皇帝享國三年。
context.next: 趙高為丞相安武侯。

translations.chinese: 趙高為丞相安武侯。
translations.literal: Zhao Gao became Chancellor Marquis Anwu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gao became Chancellor and Marquis of Anwu.

context.previous: 葬宜春。
context.next: 二世生十二年而立。

translations.chinese: 二世生十二年而立。
translations.literal: The Second Emperor was born twelve years then established.
translations.idiomatic: The Second Emperor ascended the throne at twelve years of age.

context.previous: 趙高為丞相安武侯。

translations.chinese: 右秦襄公至二世，六百一十歲。
translations.literal: From Duke Xiang of Qin to the Second Emperor, six hundred and ten years.
translations.idiomatic: From Duke Xiang of Qin to the Second Emperor was six hundred and ten years.

translations.chinese: 孝明皇帝十七年十月十五日乙丑，曰：
translations.literal: Xiao Ming emperor seventeenth year tenth month fifteenth day Yi Chou, said:
translations.idiomatic: Lü Buwei was honored throughout the world.

translations.chinese: 周歷已移，仁不代母。
translations.literal: The Zhou calendar had already shifted, benevolence does not replace the mother.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou calendar had already been superseded; benevolence cannot replace maternal authority.

context.next: 秦直其位，呂政殘虐。

translations.chinese: 秦直其位，呂政殘虐。
translations.literal: Qin took its position directly, Lü Zheng was cruel and tyrannical.
translations.idiomatic: Qin seized power directly; Lü Zheng was cruel and tyrannical.

context.previous: 周歷已移，仁不代母。
context.next: 然以諸侯十三，并兼天下，極情縱欲，養育宗親。

translations.chinese: 然以諸侯十三，并兼天下，極情縱欲，養育宗親。
translations.literal: Yet with thirteen feudal lords, unified and annexed all under heaven, indulged passions and desires to the extreme, nurtured and raised relatives of the clan.
translations.idiomatic: Yet starting with thirteen feudal lords, he unified and annexed all under heaven. He indulged his passions and desires to the extreme, nurturing and raising his clan relatives.

context.previous: 秦直其位，呂政殘虐。
context.next: 三十七年，兵無所不加，制作政令，施於後王。

translations.chinese: 三十七年，兵無所不加，制作政令，施於後王。
translations.literal: Thirty-seven years, armies applied everywhere, created systems and commands, applied to later kings.
translations.idiomatic: For thirty-seven years, his armies were deployed everywhere. He created systems and commands that were applied to later kings.

context.previous: 然以諸侯十三，并兼天下，極情縱欲，養育宗親。
context.next: 蓋得聖人之威，河神授圖，據狼、狐，蹈參、伐，佐政驅除，距之稱始皇。

translations.chinese: 蓋得聖人之威，河神授圖，據狼、狐，蹈參、伐，佐政驅除，距之稱始皇。
translations.literal: Indeed obtained sage's authority, river god bestowed charts, held Lang and Hu, trod Can and Fa, assisted government drove out, pushed away called First Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: He obtained the authority of a sage; the river god bestowed charts upon him. He held the constellations Lang and Hu, trod upon Can and Fa. He assisted in government and drove out evil, thus was called the First Emperor.

context.previous: 三十七年，兵無所不加，制作政令，施於後王。

translations.chinese: 始皇既歿，胡亥極愚，酈山未畢，復作阿房，以遂前策。
translations.literal: First Emperor already dead, Hu Hai extremely foolish, Lishan not finished, again made Epang, to fulfill previous strategy.
translations.idiomatic: After the First Emperor died, Hu Hai was extremely foolish. Lishan was not yet finished, yet he resumed construction of Epang Palace to fulfill the previous strategy.

context.next: 云「凡所為貴有天下者，肆意極欲，大臣至欲罷先君所為」。

translations.chinese: 云「凡所為貴有天下者，肆意極欲，大臣至欲罷先君所為」。
translations.literal: Said 'all what done noble having world ones, unrestrained intentions extreme desires, ministers even wished dismiss former lord what did'.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Changping Jun and Changwen Jun as generals.

context.previous: 始皇既歿，胡亥極愚，酈山未畢，復作阿房，以遂前策。
context.next: 誅斯、去疾，任用趙高。

translations.chinese: 誅斯、去疾，任用趙高。
translations.literal: Executed Si and Quji, employed Zhao Gao.
translations.idiomatic: He executed Li Si and Zhao Gao's brother Quji, and employed Zhao Gao.

context.previous: 云「凡所為貴有天下者，肆意極欲，大臣至欲罷先君所為」。
context.next: 痛哉言乎！

translations.chinese: 痛哉言乎！
translations.literal: Painful indeed words ah!
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Wei, capturing twenty cities.

context.previous: 誅斯、去疾，任用趙高。
context.next: 人頭畜鳴。

translations.chinese: 人頭畜鳴。
translations.literal: Human heads beast calls.
translations.idiomatic: Human heads spoke while beasts called out.

context.previous: 痛哉言乎！
context.next: 不威不伐惡，不篤不虛亡，距之不得留，殘虐以促期，雖居形便之國，猶不得存。

translations.chinese: 不威不伐惡，不篤不虛亡，距之不得留，殘虐以促期，雖居形便之國，猶不得存。
translations.literal: Not awe-inspiring then not extol evil, not sincere then not vainly perish, reject it cannot remain, cruel tyranny hastens the deadline, though dwell in advantageously situated state, still cannot survive.
translations.idiomatic: Without awe-inspiring presence, one cannot extol virtue and punish evil. Without sincerity, one will perish in vain. Rejecting good counsel leads to ruin; cruel tyranny hastens destruction. Even in a state with natural advantages, survival becomes impossible.

context.previous: 人頭畜鳴。

translations.chinese: 子嬰度次得嗣，冠玉冠，佩華紱，車黃屋，從百司，謁七廟。
translations.literal: Ziying assessed the sequence obtained succession, wore jade crown, wore splendid sash, rode yellow-canopied chariot, followed by hundred officials, paid respects at seven ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: Ziying assessed the proper sequence and obtained the succession. He wore the jade crown, donned the splendid sash, rode in the yellow-canopied chariot, was followed by the hundred officials, and paid respects at the seven ancestral temples.

context.next: 小人乘非位，莫不怳忽失守，偷安日日，獨能長念卻慮，父子作權，近取於戶牖之閒，竟誅猾臣，為君討賊。

translations.chinese: 小人乘非位，莫不怳忽失守，偷安日日，獨能長念卻慮，父子作權，近取於戶牖之閒，竟誅猾臣，為君討賊。
translations.literal: Petty men took improper positions, none not suddenly lost guard, stole peace day by day, alone could long consider reject worries, father and son made authority, took nearby from door window interval, finally executed cunning ministers, for lord eliminated traitors.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men took positions they did not deserve; none failed to suddenly lose their composure and abandon their duties. They sought daily comfort in complacency. Only Ziying could maintain long-term vision and reject shortsighted worries. Father and son wielded authority together, drawing power from their immediate household. In the end, they executed the treacherous ministers and eliminated traitors for their lord.

context.previous: 子嬰度次得嗣，冠玉冠，佩華紱，車黃屋，從百司，謁七廟。
context.next: 高死之後，賓婚未得盡相勞，餐未及下咽，酒未及濡脣，楚兵已屠關中，真人翔霸上，素車嬰組，奉其符璽，以歸帝者。

translations.chinese: 高死之後，賓婚未得盡相勞，餐未及下咽，酒未及濡脣，楚兵已屠關中，真人翔霸上，素車嬰組，奉其符璽，以歸帝者。
translations.literal: After Gao's death, wedding guests had not yet finished exchanging courtesies, food had not yet reached the throat, wine had not yet moistened the lips, when Chu troops had already slaughtered Guanzhong, the Worthy One soared at Baxi, plain chariot with corded yoke, presented his tally and seal, to return to the imperial one.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhao Gao's death, the wedding guests had not yet finished exchanging congratulations. Food had not yet been swallowed, wine had not yet touched their lips, when Chu troops had already massacred the Guanzhong region. The Worthy One appeared at Baxi Hill. In a plain chariot with hempen cords, he presented his imperial tally and seal to submit to the new emperor.

context.previous: 小人乘非位，莫不怳忽失守，偷安日日，獨能長念卻慮，父子作權，近取於戶牖之閒，竟誅猾臣，為君討賊。
context.next: 鄭伯茅旌鸞刀，嚴王退舍。

translations.chinese: 鄭伯茅旌鸞刀，嚴王退舍。
translations.literal: Lord of Zheng thatched banner phoenix knife, King Yan retreated abode.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord of Zheng displayed thatched banners and phoenix-decorated knives; King Yan respectfully withdrew.

context.previous: 高死之後，賓婚未得盡相勞，餐未及下咽，酒未及濡脣，楚兵已屠關中，真人翔霸上，素車嬰組，奉其符璽，以歸帝者。
context.next: 河決不可復壅，魚爛不可復全。

translations.chinese: 河決不可復壅，魚爛不可復全。
translations.literal: River breached cannot again be dammed, fish rotten cannot again be whole.
translations.idiomatic: A breached river cannot be dammed again; rotten fish cannot be made whole.

context.previous: 鄭伯茅旌鸞刀，嚴王退舍。
context.next: 賈誼、司馬遷曰：「向使嬰有庸主之才，僅得中佐，山東雖亂，秦之地可全而有，宗廟之祀未當絕也。」

translations.chinese: 賈誼、司馬遷曰：「向使嬰有庸主之才，僅得中佐，山東雖亂，秦之地可全而有，宗廟之祀未當絕也。」
translations.literal: Jia Yi, Sima Qian said: 'Suppose made Ying had ordinary lord talent, merely obtained middle assistants, east mountains though chaotic, Qin land could whole have, clan temple sacrifices not should extinguished also.'
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Zhao, capturing nine cities.

context.previous: 河決不可復壅，魚爛不可復全。
context.next: 秦之積衰，天下土崩瓦解，雖有周旦之材，無所復陳其巧，而以責一日之孤，誤哉！

translations.chinese: 秦之積衰，天下土崩瓦解，雖有周旦之材，無所復陳其巧，而以責一日之孤，誤哉！
translations.literal: Qin accumulated decline, world earth collapsed tile dissolved, though had Zhou Dan materials, nowhere again displayed his skill, and to blame one day orphan, mistake ah!
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Wei, capturing ten cities.

context.previous: 賈誼、司馬遷曰：「向使嬰有庸主之才，僅得中佐，山東雖亂，秦之地可全而有，宗廟之祀未當絕也。」
context.next: 俗傳秦始皇起罪惡，胡亥極，得其理矣。

translations.chinese: 俗傳秦始皇起罪惡，胡亥極，得其理矣。
translations.literal: Popular tradition says Qin Shihuang arose from evil, Hu Hai extreme, obtained its principle.
translations.idiomatic: Popular tradition holds that Qin Shihuang arose from wickedness, and Hu Hai carried it to extremes. This captures the essence of it.

context.previous: 秦之積衰，天下土崩瓦解，雖有周旦之材，無所復陳其巧，而以責一日之孤，誤哉！
context.next: 復責小子，云秦地可全，所謂不通時變者也。

translations.chinese: 復責小子，云秦地可全，所謂不通時變者也。
translations.literal: Again blamed the young one, said Qin territory could be preserved, called not understanding changing times.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he again blamed Ziying, saying the Qin territories could have been preserved. This is what is meant by not understanding the changing times.

context.previous: 俗傳秦始皇起罪惡，胡亥極，得其理矣。
context.next: 紀季以酅，春秋不名。

translations.chinese: 紀季以酅，春秋不名。
translations.literal: Ji Ji with Zui, Spring and Autumn Annals does not name.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Ji was enfeoffed at Zui; the Spring and Autumn Annals does not record his name.

context.previous: 復責小子，云秦地可全，所謂不通時變者也。
context.next: 吾讀秦紀，至於子嬰車裂趙高，未嘗不健其決，憐其志。

translations.chinese: 吾讀秦紀，至於子嬰車裂趙高，未嘗不健其決，憐其志。
translations.literal: I read Qin records, to Ziying cart-dismembered Zhao Gao, never not admired his decision, pitied his aspiration.
translations.idiomatic: When I read the Qin records, especially the part where Ziying had Zhao Gao torn apart by chariots, I cannot but admire his decisiveness and pity his noble intentions.

context.previous: 紀季以酅，春秋不名。
context.next: 嬰死生之義備矣。

translations.chinese: 嬰死生之義備矣。
translations.literal: Ying life death righteousness complete.
translations.idiomatic: Ziying fulfilled all the duties of life and death.

context.previous: 吾讀秦紀，至於子嬰車裂趙高，未嘗不健其決，憐其志。
